summary: A method for integrating the Langevin equations of motion for run-and-tumble particles is introduced to compute the joint distribution of their position and active velocity, with and without a harmonic external force field. The key step is the construction of the moments of the distribution and the correlation functions, conditional on the particles being in a specific state at the final time. For one-dimensional run-and-tumble particles in a harmonic external potential, the exact steady-state distributions for the tumble state, as well as for the run state conditional on a specified velocity direction, are obtained. This enables us to demonstrate their equivalence to the exact solutions of the corresponding Fokker-Planck equations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种积分run-and-tumble粒子Langevin运动方程的方法，通过构造以末态为条件的矩和关联函数，求得位置与活性速度的联合分布；在一维谐振外势下得到tumble态及给定速度方向的run态的精确稳态分布，并证明其与相应Fokker-Planck方程精确解等价。
AI.motivation: run-and-tumble粒子的位置与活性速度联合分布，尤其在外势场中的精确稳态解，通常依赖Fokker-Planck方程求解，缺乏从Langevin方程直接、系统地得到联合分布的路径。
AI.method: 直接在Langevin方程层面做路径积分/条件化：构造分布的矩与关联函数，并以粒子在末时刻处于特定状态为条件；分有、无谐振外力场两种情形处理，一维时分别推导tumble态与指定速度方向的run态的精确稳态分布，再与Fokker-Planck方程精确解对照。
AI.result: 得到一维谐振外势中tumble态及给定速度方向run态的精确稳态分布，并证明其与对应Fokker-Planck方程的精确解等价。
AI.conclusion: 该Langevin框架可在不直接求解Fokker-Planck方程的情况下给出联合分布的精确结果，为活性粒子在外势中的稳态统计提供替代且可验证的推导途径。

title: Topological Splitting of Sondheimer Oscillations in Thin-Film Weyl Semimetals
summary: We discuss topological effects on Sondheimer oscillations in the magnetoresistance of thin-film Weyl semimetals. The Sondheimer oscillations are periodic in magnetic field and originate from the commensurability between the film thickness and the cyclotron-orbit pitch. Using Boltzmann transport theory, we investigate the effects of Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment on the oscillations. We find that the Sondheimer oscillations split into two branches with different frequencies and that each branch becomes chirped because its frequency depends on magnetic field. These features originate from the orbital-Zeeman-induced deformation of the Fermi surface. The same mechanism also applies to Dirac semimetals.

AI.tldr: 本文用玻尔兹曼输运理论研究外尔半金属薄膜磁阻中Sondheimer振荡的拓扑效应,发现贝里曲率与轨道磁矩使振荡分裂为两支并产生啁啾。
AI.motivation: Sondheimer振荡源于薄膜厚度与回旋轨道螺距的匹配,是周期性于磁场的效应;但拓扑半金属中贝里曲率和轨道磁矩对这类几何共振振荡的影响此前未被探讨。
AI.method: 采用玻尔兹曼输运理论,在外尔半金属薄膜模型中引入贝里曲率与轨道磁矩,计算磁阻中的Sondheimer振荡并分析其频率结构。
AI.result: Sondheimer振荡分裂为两支具有不同频率的分支,且每支频率随磁场变化而被啁啾;其根源是orbital-Zeeman效应引起的费米面形变。相同机制亦适用于狄拉克半金属。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑能带效应(贝里曲率与轨道磁矩)显著改变薄膜Sondheimer振荡的谱特征,可作为探测外尔/狄拉克半金属拓扑性质的输运手段。

title: Strong Thermal Conductivity Suppression in Isotope Purified Single Crystal Diamond with Phonon Scatterings of Color Centers
summary: The thermal conductivity of natural diamond can be further improved by ~50% by eliminating isotope impurity to obtain pure 12C diamond. However, unlike isolated point defects, how color centers scatter phonons and correspondingly limit the thermal conductivity remain poorly understood. Here, we report the thermal conductivities of two isotope-purified diamond with different Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) color center concentrations, confirmed by photoluminescence (PL) and secondary-ion mass spectrometry (SIMS). Results show ~ 3200 W m-1 K-1 and ~ 2100 W m-1 K-1 for two samples of low and high NV concentrations, respectively. Modified Callaway model analyses show that first-principles-derived scattering parameters can reproduce room-temperature thermal conductivity of the high NV concentration sample under a vacancy concentration assumption (~30% of the total Nitrogen concentration), but fail to reproduce its temperature dependence. Compared to PL and SIMS results, which show ~7.1-fold NV concentration and ~92-fold difference in total Nitrogen concentration between two samples, suggesting the assumed 30% vacancy fraction may be greatly overestimated. Taken together, these results suggest that NV-color-center defects may scatter phonons more strongly than models treating Nitrogen and vacancy as independent point defects, providing new insights into color-center-induced phonon-scattering mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该文测量了两种同位素纯化金刚石（NV色心浓度不同）的热导率，分别为~3200和~2100 W m-1 K-1，并用修正Callaway模型分析，表明NV色心对声子的散射强于将氮与空位视为独立点缺陷的模型预测。
AI.motivation: 同位素纯化可提升金刚石热导率约50%，但色心（如NV中心）如何散射声子、限制热导率的机制尚不清楚，尤其不同于孤立点缺陷的情形。
AI.method: 对两种不同NV色心浓度的同位素纯化金刚石测量热导率，用光致发光（PL）和二次离子质谱（SIMS）确认浓度；采用修正Callaway模型并结合第一性原理散射参数进行分析。
AI.result: 低、高NV浓度样品热导率分别约3200与2100 W m-1 K-1；在假设空位浓度约为总氮浓度30%时，模型能复现高NV样品室温热导率，但无法复现其温度依赖关系。PL与SIMS显示两样品NV浓度相差约7.1倍、总氮浓度相差约92倍，说明30%空位比例可能被严重高估。
AI.conclusion: NV色心缺陷对声子的散射强于将氮与空位视为独立点缺陷的模型预测，为色心诱导声子散射机制提供新见解。

title: HEXRD and HEXRDGUI: a flexible toolkit for X-ray diffraction analysis in dynamic compression experiments
summary: This article describes the application of HEXRD, an open-source Python library for X-ray diffraction analysis, and HEXRDGUI, its companion graphical application, to dynamic compression experiments. Built on a generic multi-detector geometric model, the toolkit supports arbitrary instrument configurations with independently positioned planar or cylindrical detector panels, arbitrary beam directions, and multiple X-ray sources. It calibrates instruments from powder rings, Laue spots or the rings of an unknown phase, fits whole patterns by Le Bail or Rietveld refinement, and imports data from the TARDIS, FIDDLE and PXRDIP platforms at the National Ignition Facility (NIF) and OMEGA EP. Although originally developed for high-energy diffraction microscopy at synchrotron sources, HEXRD has been adopted as an analysis tool for dynamic compression X-ray diffraction experiments at facilities including the NIF, the Matter in Extreme Conditions end-station at the Linac Coherent Light Source, the Dynamic Compression Sector (DCS) at the Advanced Photon Source, OMEGA EP at the Laboratory for Laser Energetics, and the High Energy Density (HED) instrument at the European XFEL. Calibrated from the same ring positions on a single planar detector, HEXRD and the independent code pyFAI predict the same scattering angle 2$θ$ to numerical precision. On a dual-source dataset from the NIF, calibrating the detectors against both X-ray sources at once fits the rings of both to an RMS of 0.18° in 2$θ$, about one image-plate pixel, whereas a fit to either source alone, with the plate tilts held at their nominal values, fits its own rings nearly as well but mispredicts the other's by about 0.6°. The software is freely available under a BSD license.

AI.tldr: 介绍开源X射线衍射分析工具HEXRD及其图形界面HEXRDGUI在动压缩实验中的应用，支持任意探测器几何、多种标定与全谱拟合方法，并与pyFAI验证一致、在多源NIF数据上实现精确标定。
AI.motivation: 动压缩X射线衍射实验（NIF、LCLS-MEC、DCS、OMEGA EP、EuXFEL HED等）仪器配置复杂、探测器可独立摆放且常用多X射线源，缺乏通用、开源且能处理任意几何的分析工具，HEXRD原为同步辐射HEDM开发，需推广并验证其在动压缩场景的适用性。
AI.method: 基于通用多探测器几何模型，支持任意光束方向、多个X射线源、独立摆位的平面或圆柱探测器面板；用粉末环、Laue斑点或未知相衍射环标定仪器；支持Le Bail与Rietveld全谱拟合；可导入NIF的TARDIS、FIDDLE及PXRDIP平台数据；与独立代码pyFAI对比2θ预测，并在NIF双源数据上比较单源与双源联合标定。
AI.result: 在同一平面探测器的相同环位置标定下，HEXRD与pyFAI对2θ的预测在数值精度上一致；NIF双源数据中，同时用两个源标定可将两套环拟合至2θ的0.18° RMS（约一个成像板像素），而仅用单一源、倾斜角固定为标称值时虽能较好拟合自身环，但对另一源环的预测偏差约0.6°。
AI.conclusion: HEXRD/HEXRDGUI是适用于动压缩实验的通用、经交叉验证且免费（BSD许可）的XRD分析工具，多源联合标定对多源实验几何至关重要，建议在类似装置中采用。

title: Extrinsic Bulk Photovoltaic Effect from Asymmetric Defect Scattering
summary: The extrinsic bulk photovoltaic effect from asymmetric electron-defect scattering can make an important contribution to the total photocurrent and is highly diagnostic of defect type. We present an ab initio Boltzmann framework combining optical excitation with electron-phonon and symmetric and skew electron-defect scattering, and we apply it to monolayer GeS. Because the defects that generate the current also relax the anisotropy that sustains it, the response peaks at a finite defect fraction. Within the scattering-limited model, cooling to $0$~K shifts the peak position toward lower defect fractions and yields a maximum enhancement of more than six orders of magnitude at fixed defect fraction. At selected low-temperature defect fractions, the total extrinsic current can exceed the intrinsic shift current by more than an order of magnitude, so that the defect fraction itself becomes a tunable parameter.

AI.tldr: 该文建立从头算玻尔兹曼框架，统一处理光学激发、电子-声子散射及对称与偏斜电子-缺陷散射，研究单层GeS中的外禀体光伏效应，发现电流随缺陷比例出现峰值，低温下可相比内禀位移电流增强一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 由非对称电子-缺陷散射产生的"外禀"体光伏效应对总光电流有重要贡献，且能用于判别缺陷类型；但缺乏能同时描述光学激发与本征/外禀散射通道的定量理论框架。
AI.method: 构建从头算玻尔兹曼输运框架，将光学激发与电子-声子散射、对称及偏斜（skew）电子-缺陷散射结合，并应用于单层GeS。
AI.result: 因产生电流的缺陷同时破坏维持电流的各向异性，响应在有限缺陷比例处达到峰值；在散射受限模型下，降温至0 K使峰值移向更低缺陷比例，固定缺陷比例时最大增强超过六个数量级；在选定低温缺陷比例下，总外禀电流可超过内禀位移电流一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷比例本身可作为可调参数来优化体光伏响应，外禀机制在低温下可主导光电流，为缺陷工程调控光伏效应提供理论依据。

title: Interaction-driven competing instabilities in two-dimensional checkerboard quadratic band crossing semimetals
summary: Two-dimensional quadratic band crossing point (QBCP) semimetals serve as a fertile platform for interaction-driven quantum criticality, nevertheless, the role of the complete fermion-fermion interactions remains largely unexplored. To address this, we systematically investigate the low-energy physics of a spin-1/2 checkerboard-lattice QBCP semimetal by considering all 16 marginally short-range fermion-fermion interactions. Using the momentum-shell renormalization group, we derive the coupled flow equations, which reveal that the low-energy physics is governed by a series of fixed points. Depending on the initial conditions, the system may exhibit a single stable fixed point, several discrete fixed points, or three continuous groups of fixed points parameterized by a few variables. By introducing source terms and evaluating susceptibilities, we identify the dominant and subdominant instabilities. The leading phases include nematic spin-nematic (NSN), quantum anomalous Hall (QAH), chiral superconducting ($\mathrm{SC}_1$), and quantum spin Hall (QSH) orders. Moreover, several features distinguish our findings from previous simplified models. Off-diagonal interactions generate terms that promote orders absent in such models, the continuous groups allow systematic tuning of the leading instability, and trajectory-dependent instabilities emerge where the full RG flow, rather than the fixed point alone, determines the dominant state. These results offer a comprehensive theoretical understanding of low-energy quantum critical behaviors and phase instabilities in two-dimensional QBCP semimetals and related electron systems.

AI.tldr: 系统考虑全部16种边缘短程费米子-费米子相互作用，对spin-1/2棋盘格子QBCP半金属做动量壳RG分析，揭示多类不动点及NSN、QAH、手征SC、QSH等主导不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 二维二次能带交叉点半金属是相互作用驱动量子临界的重要平台，但完整的费米子-费米子相互作用在其低能物理中的作用尚不清楚，已有工作多采用简化模型。
AI.method: 对自旋1/2棋盘格子QBCP半金属，纳入全部16种边缘短程费米子-费米子相互作用，采用动量壳重整化群推导耦合流方程，分析不动点结构；再引入源项并计算磁化率以识别主导与次主导不稳定性。
AI.result: 低能物理由一系列不动点支配：依初条件可呈单一稳定不动点、若干离散不动点，或由少数变量参数化的三组连续不动点。主导相包括向列自旋向列(NSN)、量子反常霍尔(QAH)、手征超导(SC1)和量子自旋霍尔(QSH)。非对角相互作用产生简化模型中没有的项；连续不动点组可系统调节主导不稳定性；还存在依赖轨迹的不稳定性，即由完整RG流而非仅不动点决定主导态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出二维QBCP半金属及相关电子体系低能量子临界行为与相不稳定性的全面理论图像，并表明完整相互作用集合引入简化模型所缺失的物理。

title: Large Deviations in Switching Diffusion: Dynamical Condensation and Diffusivity BBP Transition
summary: We consider a Brownian particle with position $x(t)$ whose diffusivity changes at Poissonian switching times, with each new value drawn independently from a bounded distribution $W(D)$. Assuming $W(D)\sim C(D_{\max}-D)^ν$ near its upper edge, we study the large-deviation regime $x(t)\simeq yt$ with $y = O(1)$ at large times, far beyond the typical diffusive scale. In a recent work Guéneau et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 067102 (2025), the rate function of the displacement was obtained through a renewal approach and it was shown to display several singularities. In this paper, we carry out a detailed study of the corresponding dynamical phase transitions and trajectory condensation. For moderate $y$, the imposed displacement is shared among $O(t)$ displacement increments accumulated during successive intervals between switches. Beyond a first threshold $y_-$, one interval produces an increment of order $t$ carrying a finite fraction of the total displacement, signaling dynamical condensation. For $ν>1$, a second threshold $y_+>y_-$ is reached when this macroscopic increment carries asymptotically the entire imposed displacement, whereas for $0<ν\leq1$ the two thresholds merge, $y_-=y_+$. In turn, the moment-generating function of $x(t)$ displays a complementary transition from collective contributions of many diffusivities to selection of states near $D_{\max}$. We show that this transition is governed by the same edge mechanism as the Baik-Ben Arous-Péché (BBP) transition, indicating that diffusivity selection and trajectory condensation are two manifestations of the same phenomenon. We validate our predictions for the dynamical condensation against numerical results from rare event sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文深入研究扩散系数按Poisson切换的Brownian粒子的罕见位移大偏差，揭示动力学凝聚与相变，并将其与BBP边缘机制统一起来。
AI.motivation: Guéneau等(PRL 2025)用更新方法得到速率函数并发现奇异性，但奇异性的物理机制——动力学相变与轨迹凝聚——尚需细致刻画。
AI.method: 设$W(D)\sim C(D_{\max}-D)^\nu$，研究$y=O(1)$的大偏差$y t$；分析位移增量分配随$y$变化，并用矩生成函数表述，辅以罕见事件抽样数值验证。
AI.result: 中等$y$时位移由$O(t)$个增量均分；超阈值$y_-$后单个区间贡献$O(t)$增量即动力学凝聚；$\nu>1$时存在$y_+>y_-$使该宏观增量占全部位移，$0<\nu\le1$时两阈值合并。MGF相应从多扩散系数集体贡献过渡到$D_{\max}$附近态的选择，受与BBP相变相同的边缘机制支配。
AI.conclusion: 扩散系数选择与轨迹凝聚是同一现象的两种表现，二者均由BBP式边缘机制驱动；数值罕见事件采样验证了凝聚预测。

title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and deconfined criticality in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, and Supplemental Material
summary: SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ is the leading candidate for deconfined criticality, yet theories of its critical regime omit the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions, which gap the kagome Dirac spin liquid. Adding them to the SU(2) gauge theory, we show that time reversal and a spin-orbit-locked glide forbid any gauge-singlet spinon mass to all orders. In-plane DM only twists the spinons, reconstructing the nodes below $0.03$-$0.17$ K, while out-of-plane DM is irrelevant and SO(5) anisotropy arises only at second order. The material thus remains a platform for deconfined criticality, which NMR can test, since a $[100]$ field induces a Néel moment and a $[001]$ field does not.

AI.tldr: 本文研究DM相互作用对SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$中kagome Dirac自旋液体及去禁闭临界性的影响，表明DM并不能打开自旋子能隙，材料仍是去禁闭临界性的候选平台。
AI.motivation: SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$是去禁闭临界性的主要候选材料，但已有临界理论忽略了会使kagome Dirac自旋液体产生能隙的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用，亟需评估其是否破坏该临界性。
AI.method: 在SU(2)规范理论中加入DM项，分析时间反演与自旋-轨道锁定的滑移对称性对规范单态自旋子质量项的约束，并分别讨论面内与面外DM的作用及相关性，以及SO(5)各向异性的出现阶数。
AI.result: 时间反演与自旋-轨道锁定的滑移对称性在所有阶上禁止任何规范单态自旋子质量；面内DM仅"扭曲"自旋子，使节点在0.03–0.17 K以下重构；面外DM为无关微扰；SO(5)各向异性仅在二阶出现。并预言[100]方向磁场诱导Néel矩而[001]方向磁场不诱导，可由NMR检验。
AI.conclusion: DM相互作用不破坏SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$中的去禁闭临界性，该材料仍是可行的候选平台，并给出可用NMR验证的可观测判据。

title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions in the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids
summary: We classify the fermion bilinears of the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids under the spin-orbit-locked space group and treat the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions of SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ at leading order in $1/N$ and at one loop. At linear order DM can neither gap the spinons nor destabilize the SO(5) point above a scale $T^*$. Symmetry forbids every local gauge-singlet fermion mass at any order. Among the singlet bilinears, the in-plane couplings induce only a conserved spin current of dimension exactly 2, which sets $T^*=4λ\simeq0.03$-$0.17$ K, and the out-of-plane coupling only a flavored spin-2 current, irrelevant at a unitary critical point. DM-induced Yukawa couplings start below $2\%$ of the one that bounds the pseudocritical window. In zero field, measured samples order above $1$ K, at or above $T^*$. Below $T^*$, in a two-dimensional sample at the critical pressure, the Dirac cones reconstruct into a chirally protected $d$-wave quadratic band touching whose only gauge-singlet gap channels are the two valence-bond components and the scalar chirality. A one-loop flow, with the gauge field screened by the band touching, ends at $T^{**}\sim(0.03$-$0.1)λ$ on a ray containing valence-bond order for the material's exchange and for most random couplings, and otherwise on a gapped chiral $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin liquid. The DM bias between the two plaquette patterns is at most of order $10^{-4}$, with a direction not fixed at $O(1/N)$, whereas non-magnetic quenched disorder couples a relevant random field to the plaquette doublet and none to the chirality. A field along $[100]$ induces a $(π,π)$ Néel moment linear in the field; a field along $[001]$ does not. This selection rule also holds in the dimer phase and is testable by $^{11}$B NMR under pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文在自旋轨道锁定的空间群下对Shastry-Sutherland Dirac自旋液体的SU(2)规范理论进行费米子双线性分类，并在1/N领头阶及单圈水平处理SrCu₂(BO₃)₂的DM相互作用。结果表明DM在近邻耦合下无法打开自旋子能隙，对称性禁止任何局域规范单态费米子质量，由此确定赝临界窗口上界T*≈0.03–0.17 K，并在临界压强下给出无能隙到价键/手性Z₂液体的RG流向以及可被¹¹B NMR检验的场方向选择定则。
AI.motivation: SrCu₂(BO₃)₂等Shastry-Sutherland磁体实验显示自旋液体迹象，但Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用是否破坏Dirac自旋液体（打开自旋子能隙或失稳SO(5)临界点）此前未在规范理论框架内系统回答，需要将DM作为微扰在1/N与单圈水平加以判定。
AI.method: 在自旋轨道锁定的空间群下分类SU(2)规范理论的费米子双线性；在1/N领头阶和单圈精度处理DM相互作用；用对称性论证排除局域规范单态费米子质量；计算规范场所需的圈图筛蔽，并对重构后d波二次能带接触做单圈RG流分析；讨论淬火无序与随机场的耦合。
AI.result: 线性阶DM既不能打开自旋子能隙，也不能在T*以上失稳SO(5)点；面内耦合只产生唯象维度恰为2的守恒自旋流，给出T*=4λ≈0.03–0.17 K，面外耦合只产生不可约的味自旋-2流。DM诱导的Yukawa耦合小于限制赝临界窗口者之2%。T*以下临界压强下，Dirac锥重构为手性保护的d波二次能带接触，规范单态能隙通道仅有价键双重态与标量手性；单圈流终结于T**~(0.03–0.1)λ，处于价键序射线上（对本材料交换及多数随机耦合），否则为有隙手性Z₂自旋液体。两plaquette图案的DM偏置≤10⁻⁴且方向不在O(1/N)确定；非磁淬火无序对plaquette双重态给出相关随机场而对螺旋度无耦合。沿[100]的磁场诱导正比于场的(π,π)奈尔矩，沿[001]则无；该选择定则在二聚相同样成立，可用加压¹¹B NMR检验。
AI.conclusion: DM相互作用不足以破坏Dirac自旋液体或SO(5)临界性，T*以下系统经由手性保护的能带重构进入价键序或手性Z₂自旋液体；无序选择性地偏向plaquette序，而磁场方向选择定则提供了明确的NMR实验判据。

title: Large exchange bias from coupled antiferromagnetic order and glassy magnetic freezing in $Co_{0.36}NbS_{2}$
summary: Magnetization measurements on single-crystalline $Co_{0.36}NbS_{2}$ reveal antiferromagnetic order near $T_{N} \simeq 26 K$ and a lower-temperature history-dependent magnetic response consistent with glassy freezing of a subset of magnetic moments. After field cooling, $M(H)$ loops exhibit a sizable exchange-bias shift, reaching $|H_{EB}| \simeq 4.4 kOe$ at $1.8 K$ for a $70 kOe$ field-cooling sweep protocol. The training effect, field-sweep and cooling-field protocol dependence, and disappearance of the bias near a blocking temperature $T_{B} \simeq 12 K$, well below $T_{N}$, support an interpretation in which frozen uncompensated moments are exchange-coupled to an antiferromagnetic matrix. These results suggest that antiferromagnetic-glassy-moment coupling may provide a broader route to exchange bias in off-stoichiometric magnetic $NbS_{2}$ intercalates.

AI.tldr: 单晶Co0.36NbS2在TN≈26 K出现反铁磁序，并在更低温度表现出与部分磁矩玻璃态冻结一致的历史依赖磁响应；场冷后出现大交换偏置（1.8 K时|HEB|≈4.4 kOe），在远低于TN的阻塞温度TB≈12 K附近消失，符合冻结未补偿磁矩与反铁磁基体交换耦合的图像。
AI.motivation: 探索非化学计量磁性NbS2插层化合物中的交换偏置机制，检验"反铁磁-玻璃态磁矩耦合"能否作为获得交换偏置的更普适途径。
AI.method: 对单晶Co0.36NbS2进行磁化测量：变温磁化确定TN与玻璃态冻结行为；场冷后测M(H)回线获得交换偏置；考察训练效应、场扫速率与冷却场协议依赖性，并追踪偏置随温度的演化以确定阻塞温度。
AI.result: TN≈26 K附近呈反铁磁序，低温磁响应具历史依赖性；70 kOe场冷协议下1.8 K时|HEB|≈4.4 kOe；交换偏置在TB≈12 K附近消失，且表现训练效应与冷却场/场扫协议依赖。
AI.conclusion: 交换偏置源于冻结的未补偿磁矩与反铁磁基体的交换耦合，而非典型铁磁/反铁磁界面；反铁磁-玻璃态磁矩耦合或为非化学计量磁性NbS2插层体系乃至更广泛材料中实现交换偏置的通用途径。

title: The Ericson Transition in Time-Reversal Invariant Systems: Orthogonally Invariant Hamiltonians
summary: We investigate the distributions of off-diagonal scattering matrix elements and cross-sections in the Ericson regime for systems that are time-reversal and rotationally invariant. In previous works, we developed techniques to analyze the Ericson transition by means of asymptotic expansions in the cases of unitarily and symplectically invariant Hamiltonians. Here, we prove that Gaussian and exponential behavior is found as the leading-order term of an asymptotic expansion of those distributions also in the orthogonal case, which is often the relevant one for analyzing experiments. Moreover, we derive the subleading-order term and compare with numerical simulations. Finally, we discuss similarities and differences of the Ericson transition for all three Wigner-Dyson classes.

AI.tldr: 本文用渐近展开研究了正交对称类（时间反演与旋转不变）下Ericson区非对角散射矩阵元与截面的分布，证明其领头阶为高斯与指数形式，并给出次领头阶与数值模拟的比较。
AI.motivation: 此前工作已用渐近展开分析幺正类与辛类的Ericson转变，但正交类（实验中最常用）尚缺相应严格结果，本文补上这一缺口并统一比较三类Wigner-Dyson行为。
AI.method: 在正交（时间反演+旋转不变）情形下，对Ericson区非对角S矩阵元及截面的分布做渐近展开，推导领头阶与次领头阶项并对照数值模拟。
AI.result: 正交情形下分布的领头阶渐近项呈高斯（S矩阵元）与指数（截面）行为；给出次领头阶修正，与数值模拟吻合；并比较三类Wigner-Dyson类中Ericson转变的异同。
AI.conclusion: 正交类的Ericson统计与幺正、辛类在结构上类似，但细节不同；渐近展开框架对三类对称性统一适用，为实验分析提供理论依据。

title: Annealing Dynamics of the Two-Dimensional Fully Frustrated Ising Model
summary: We study the dynamical scaling properties of the two-dimensional fully frustrated Ising model by simulated annealing. The model has a highly degenerate, critical ground state with well known equilibrium properties. To study its out-of-equilibrium behavior, we develop an annealing protocol that is convenient for extending the Kibble-Zurek mechanism to the case of an exponentially divergent correlation length in the limit of the temperature $T \to T_c = 0$. We find excellent agreement with the scaling forms derived, including a dependence on the initial temperature that is not present in the conventional Kibble-Zurek mechanism. The dynamic exponent $z$ is consistent among all quantities studied; fits of its dependence on the initial temperature give $z = 1.99(2)$ (susceptibility), $z = 2.072(8)$ (excess energy), and $z = 2.09(3)$ (Edwards-Anderson order parameter). These values are close to $z=2$, which is consistent with previous studies of relaxation after instantaneous quenches and of time dependent correlations in equilibrium, including the estimate $z = 2.004(9)$ from equilibrium autocorrelation functions.

AI.tldr: 用模拟退火研究二维完全阻挫Ising模型的动力学标度，将Kibble-Zurek机制推广到T_c=0、关联长度指数发散的情形，测得动力学指数z≈2。
AI.motivation: 该模型基态高度简并且临界温度为T_c=0、关联长度随T→0指数发散，常规Kibble-Zurek机制的假设不再直接适用，需要专门设计退火协议考察其非平衡动力学。
AI.method: 采用模拟退火，为此设计一种适配T_c=0并可与指数发散关联长度相容的退火方案，推导相应的标度形式，并从磁化率、过剩能量和Edwards-Anderson序参量中提取动力学指数z。
AI.result: 标度形式的拟合与模拟结果高度吻合，并发现存在常规KZ机制所没有的初始温度依赖；各量的z一致：磁化率z=1.99(2)、过剩能量z=2.072(8)、EA序参量z=2.09(3)，均接近z=2。
AI.conclusion: 结果与瞬时空冷弛豫及平衡态时间关联研究的z(如平衡自关联给出的z=2.004(9))一致，表明T_c=0的完全阻挫Ising模型具有稳健的z≈2动力学，且KZ机制经适当推广仍适用。

title: Frustration-Assisted Electrical Switching in $Co_xTaS_2$
summary: Electrical switching in antiferromagnets is commonly described as the action of current-induced torques on a rigid order parameter. In frustrated magnets, however, competing states can create a history-dependent energy landscape in which slow collective dynamics actively participate in electrical reconfiguration. Here, we demonstrate frustration-assisted switching in near-stoichiometric $Co_xTaS_2$, a van der Waals antiferromagnet located at the composition-sensitive boundary between Hall-active and Hall-inactive multi-Q-related magnetic regimes. Although the crystals exhibit no resolved spontaneous Hall response, they retain van Hove singularities near the Fermi level and order antiferromagnetically below $T_N \simeq 31.5 K$. Current pulses write nonvolatile anisotropic resistance states in microstructured devices, with an activation current density nearly an order of magnitude below that reported for the Hall-active lower-intercalation phase. The switching response separates into two temperature-dependent dynamical regimes rather than following a single current threshold. Independent magnetization-aging and post-field-relaxation measurements reveal slow, history-dependent magnetic dynamics, and the relaxation strength closely follows the inverse switching amplitude. These results identify magnetic frustration and glassy dynamics as central ingredients in the electrical reconfiguration of $Co_xTaS_2$, establishing a route to functional switching through a dynamically soft antiferromagnetic landscape.

AI.tldr: 在近化学计量比的Co_xTaS_2（范德华反铁磁体，位于Hall活性/非活性多Q磁区边界）中实现"阻挫辅助"电致开关：无自发Hall响应但保留费米面附近的van Hove奇点，T_N≈31.5 K以下反铁磁序。电流脉冲写入非易失各向异性电阻态，激活电流密度比Hall活性低插层相约低一个数量级；开关响应呈现两个温度依赖的动力学区间而非单一电流阈值，磁化老化与场后弛豫显示缓慢的、历史依赖的磁动力学，且弛豫强度与开关幅度成反比。
AI.motivation: 传统反铁磁电致开关依赖电流力矩作用于刚性序参量。在阻挫磁体中，竞争态形成历史依赖的能垒景观，慢的集体动力学可能主动参与电重构，这一机制尚未被用于实现低功耗、功能性开关。
AI.method: 选取近化学计量比Co_xTaS_2（处于Hall活性与Hall非活性多Q区间的成分敏感边界）单晶与微结构器件；输运测量（Hall响应、van Hove奇点）、磁化测量（老化、场后弛豫）及脉冲电流写入各向异性电阻态。
AI.result: 晶体无分辨的自发Hall响应，但费米面附近存在van Hove奇点，T_N≈31.5 K以下反铁磁序；电流脉冲写入非易失各向异性电阻态，激活电流密度比Hall活性低插层相低近一个数量级；开关响应分为两个温度依赖的动力学区间而非单一阈值；弛豫强度与开关幅度近似成反比。
AI.conclusion: 磁阻挫与玻璃态动力学是Co_xTaS_2电重构的核心要素，为通过"动力学软"的反铁磁能垒景观实现功能开关提供了新途径。

title: Electric Hidden Unconventional Collinear Magnetism in 2D \(\mathcal{PT}\)-Symmetric Antiferromagnets
summary: Electric hidden unconventional collinear magnetism, in which a perpendicular electric field (\(\mathcal{E}_z\)) lifts the \(\mathcal{PT}\)-enforced degeneracy and selectively releases the hidden crystallographic constraints in conventional 2D antiferromagnets to drive emergent magnetic phases, has remained largely unexplored. Here we establish a complete symmetry classification of all 88 collinear spin layer groups (cSLGs) compatible with conventional \(\mathcal{PT}\)-symmetric antiferromagnets, and show that the \(\mathcal{E}_z\) drives the system into three distinct classes of unconventional collinear magnetism: type-IV magnetism (Class-I, 23 cSLGs), altermagnetism (Class-II, 34 cSLGs), and fully compensated ferrimagnetism (Class-III, 31 cSLGs). We illustrate these categories using the most common and feasibly exfoliable 2D candidate materials. These include Sr$_2$CaCr$_2$P$_2$O$_9$ and Sr$_2$CaCr$_2$As$_2$O$_9$ (Class-I), BaMnGe and MnPS$_3$ (Class-II), and Sr$_3$Fe$_2$O$_5$Cl$_2$ and bilayer MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ (Class-III). We further demonstrate that the \(\mathcal{E}_z\) generates distinctly different spin-splitting fingerprints across the three classes, yielding distinct spin-dependent responses: the electric Hall effect in Class-I, spin-polarized transport in Class-II, and the electric reversible magneto-optical Kerr effect in Class-III. Our work not only closes a complete internal cycle from conventional to unconventional collinear magnetism in 2D antiferromagnets, but also establishes a viable all-electrical compensated magnetism platform and control scheme for future spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 该文对88个共线自旋层群做完整对称性分类，证明垂直电场可将常规PT反铁磁体驱动为三类非常规共线磁性，并给出材料实例与独特自旋响应。
AI.motivation: 电控"隐藏"非常规共线磁性（电场解除PT强制简并、释放隐藏晶格约束而产生新磁相）研究甚少，缺乏系统的对称性分类与材料实现方案。
AI.method: 建立与常规PT对称反铁磁兼容的全部88个共线自旋层群（cSLG）的完整对称性分类，分析垂直电场ℰz下简并解除与约束释放，并在可剥离的典型2D候选材料上举例说明。
AI.result: ℰz驱动出三类非常规共线磁性：type-IV磁性（Class-I，23个cSLG）、交错磁性（Class-II，34个）、全补偿铁磁（Class-III，31个）。材料示例：Sr2CaCr2P2O9/Sr2CaCr2As2O9（I）、BaMnGe/MnPS3（II）、Sr3Fe2O5Cl2/双层MnBi2Te4（III）。三类给出不同自旋劈裂指纹，对应电学霍尔效应（I）、自旋极化输运（II）、电可控磁光克尔效应（III）。
AI.conclusion: 工作闭合了2D反铁磁体从常规到非常规共线磁性的完整内部循环，并建立可行的全电学补偿磁性平台与调控方案，服务未来自旋电子学应用。

title: Unconventional spin momentum locking and topological domains in twisted slabs of topological insulator Bi$_2$Te$_3$
summary: The three-dimensional topological insulator Bi$_2$Te$_3$ hosts topological Dirac states on its two-dimensional surfaces. These Dirac states show spin-momentum locking, which usually implies a tangential Rashba-like spin texture. One can alter the properties of the Dirac states by dividing a slab of such a material into two thinner halves, modifying the interface by twisting, shifting, and changing the interlayer distance. Using first-principles calculations, we investigate such modified slabs of Bi$_2$Te$_3$. The twisting degree of freedom deserves special attention. To this end, we follow two approaches. On the one hand, we probe different stacking configurations in order to extract parameters relevant for small twist angle Moiré structures. We find non-trivial topology only for some stackings, leading to topological domains on the Moiré scale. On the other hand, we calculate the properties of commensurate twisted supercells. The latter reveals not only flat bands, which are tunable by external pressure, but also radial spin textures with unconventional spin-momentum locking.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理计算研究Bi2Te3薄片在扭转、平移和层间距调控下层间界面对拓扑Dirac态的影响,发现某些堆垛才具非平凡拓扑而形成莫尔尺度拓扑畴,共格扭转超胞中出现可调平带及径向自旋织构。
AI.motivation: Bi2Te3表面Dirac态具自旋-动量锁定和切向Rashba型自旋织构。作者希望通过将块体劈成两半并扭转、平移、改层间距来调控界面Dirac态性质,尤其关注扭转自由度对拓扑与自旋织构的影响。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算,从两方面入手:(1)扫描不同堆垛构型,提取适用于小扭转角莫尔结构的参数;(2)直接构建共格扭转超胞进行计算。
AI.result: 仅部分堆垛呈现非平凡拓扑,导致莫尔尺度上的拓扑畴;共格扭转超胞中出现平带(可由外压调节)以及具有非常规自旋-动量锁定的径向自旋织构。
AI.conclusion: 扭转是调控Bi2Te3薄片界面Dirac态的有效自由度,可产生拓扑畴、可调平带与径向自旋织构,为莫尔拓扑与自旋电子学设计提供途径。

title: Electronic structure, magnetic order and anisotropic magnetoresistance in $\mathbf{Eu_{1-x}Gd_xCd_2P_2}$ (0 $\le$ x $\le$1)
summary: Recently, $\text{EuCd}_2\text{P}_2$ has attracted increased attention for its colossal magnetoresistive (CMR) property, the mechanism of which seems to deviate from that of known canonical CMR compounds such as manganites. Many studies underscore the role of low density of hole carriers caused by Eu vacancies, particularly in stabilizing ferromagnetic (FM) order and modifying electrical transport and magnetoresistive responses in this compound. A magnetic polaron based mechanism rather than double exchange based mechanism is being proposed to explain the CMR effect for this compound. In this work, we explore the effect of elctron doping on the magnetic transition and CMR behaviour via Gd substitution at Eu sites with varying concentration (x) in Eu$_{1-x}$Gd$_{x}$Cd$_2$P$_2$. Our Density Functional Theory (DFT) and Monte Carlo-based calculations reveal an oscillating ground state magnetic order as a function of electron carrier density. The ground state is found to be A-AFM metal for x=0.056, 0.125 and 0.5 while it becomes ferromagnetic metal at x= 0.33, 0.67 and 1. Most importantly, we predict colossal anisotropic magnetoresistance in this compound for x=0.125 and 0.5. The underlying mechanism of anisotropic CMR in this compound looks similar to double exchange like due to the presence of a strong intra-site 4\textit{f}-5\textit{d} ferromagnetic exchange interaction and an itinerant electron in the hybridized conduction states. The oscillating ground state magnetic order and the enhancement of transition temperature (as high as 150K for x=0.67) as a function of electron carrier density offers a new avenue to tune the magnetotransport property in this compound and offers an excellent platform for designing future spintronics devices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DFT与蒙特卡洛方法，研究Gd取代Eu（Eu1-xGdxCd2P2）引入电子掺杂对磁序与庞磁阻的影响，发现基态磁序随电子载流子浓度振荡，并在x=0.125和0.5时预言巨各向异性磁阻。
AI.motivation: EuCd2P2因庞磁阻（CMR）受到关注，但其机制不同于锰氧化物等经典CMR材料，普遍认为与Eu空位导致的低空穴载流子浓度及磁极化子机制相关。作者希望通过电子掺杂（Gd取代Eu）系统调控载流子浓度，考察其对磁转变与CMR行为的影响并厘清机制。
AI.method: 在Eu1-xGdxCd2P2中改变Gd浓度x实现电子掺杂，采用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合蒙特卡洛模拟计算不同电子载流子浓度下的基态磁序、电子结构与磁输运性质，并分析其微观交换相互作用机制。
AI.result: 基态磁序随电子载流子浓度呈振荡变化：x=0.056、0.125、0.5时为A型反铁磁金属，x=0.33、0.67、1时为铁磁金属；在x=0.125和0.5时预言出现巨各向异性磁阻；x=0.67时磁转变温度可提升至约150 K。作者指出该各向异性CMR机制近似双交换型，源于强在位4f-5d铁磁交换与杂化导态中的巡游电子。
AI.conclusion: 电子掺杂可有效调控EuCd2P2的基态磁序、磁转变温度与磁输运性质，其中振荡型磁序和转变温度提升为设计自旋电子学器件提供了新途径与材料平台。

title: Long-lived nonequilibrium spin configuration induced by dual optical excitation
summary: The ability to create and control nonequilibrium spin states is central to understanding ultrafast magnetism and to developing optical routes for manipulating magnetic materials beyond conventional thermal pathways.In metallic systems, photoexcited electronic distributions rapidly evolve toward quasi-thermal states through efficient electron-electron and electron-phonon scattering, making long-lived modification of spin-dependent interactions difficult to achieve. Here, we investigate coherent magnetization precession in an amorphous GdFeCo thin film driven by simultaneous excitation with two femtosecond laser pulses.Using a symmetric dual-pump geometry that continuously evolves from single-pulse to spatially periodic excitation, we separate effects associated with the excitation pattern from those arising from simultaneous dual-pump excitation. We identify a narrow excitation window in which the lifetime of the ferromagnetic-resonance-like mode increases strongly while its frequency exhibits a small but reproducible increase.Time-window analysis shows that the enhanced lifetime persists for several hundred picoseconds, substantially longer than transient magnetostatic effects associated with the periodic excitation pattern.The combined frequency and decay time changes cannot be explained by spatially structured heating alone and instead point to a long-lived nonequilibrium spin-dependent electronic configuration. Within a phenomenological Elliott-Yafet framework, the simultaneous increase in FMR decay time and frequency is consistent with a transient reduction of the effective spin-mixing parameter governing spin-flip scattering. Our results demonstrate that the excitation pathway, rather than excitation energy alone, can serve as a control parameter for spin relaxation and provide access to nonequilibrium spin states that are not readily reached by conventional single-pulse excitation.

AI.tldr: 双脉冲飞秒激光激发非晶GdFeCo薄膜，在特定激发窗口下观测到类铁磁共振模式的寿命显著延长、频率小幅上升，指向长寿命的非平衡自旋相关电子态。
AI.motivation: 金属体系中光激发电子分布经电子-电子与电子-声子散射迅速趋于准热态，难以实现自旋相关相互作用的长时间调控；作者希望探索激发方式（而非激发能量）能否成为自旋弛豫的控制参数。
AI.method: 用对称双泵浦几何（从单脉冲连续过渡到空间周期激发）激发非晶GdFeCo薄膜，测量相干磁化进动，并通过时间窗口分析区分空间激发图样效应与双脉冲同时激发效应。
AI.result: 发现一个狭窄激发窗口，其间FMR类模式的寿命大幅增加、频率小幅但可重复地升高；寿命增强持续数百皮秒，远长于周期性激发图样引起的瞬态静磁效应，且无法用空间结构化加热解释。
AI.conclusion: 结合Elliott-Yafet唯象框架，FMR衰减时间与频率同时增加可用有效自旋混合参数（控制自旋翻转散射）的瞬态降低来解释；表明激发路径本身可作为自旋弛豫控制参数，获得单脉冲激发难以达到的非平衡自旋态。

title: Tensor network Monte Carlo study of the J1-J2 Ising model on the square lattice
summary: The frustrated square-lattice J1-J2 Ising model exhibits rich magnetic phases, yet its phase transitions remain difficult to characterize due to critical slowing down in conventional Monte Carlo and truncation errors inherent to tensor renormalization group methods. We develop a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) algorithm for this frustrated model, which supports both open and periodic boundary conditions. For periodic lattices, we use a sweeping block-update strategy that updates spin blocks while fixing surrounding spins. To boost efficiency, we couple our sampler with histogram reweighting, and test each technique standalone to validate these independent optimizations. We perform extensive finite-size scaling analyses at g=0.55 and g=1.0, extracting apparent critical temperatures and effective thermal exponents from Binder-cumulant data. Our method offers an efficient, nearly bias-free path for large-scale simulations of J1-J2-type frustrated magnets under periodic boundaries and generalizes readily to other frustrated spin lattices.

AI.tldr: 该文提出张量网络蒙特卡洛(TNMC)算法，结合扫描块更新与直方图重加权，高效研究阻挫方格子J1-J2 Ising模型的相变，并支持周期边界条件。
AI.motivation: J1-J2 Ising模型磁性相丰富但相变难以刻画：常规蒙特卡洛存在临界慢化，张量重正化群有截断误差。作者希望找到高效且几乎无偏的模拟方法。
AI.method: 发展适用于阻挫模型的TNMC算法，支持开边界与周期边界；周期格子上采用扫描式块更新(固定周围自旋、更新自旋块)；并将采样器与直方图重加权耦合，对各技术单独测试以验证优化效果；在g=0.55与g=1.0做有限尺寸标度分析，从Binder累积量提取表观临界温度与有效热指数。
AI.result: 成功实现周期边界下的大规模模拟，得到两个g值的表观临界温度与有效热指数，并验证块更新与直方图重加权各自的独立有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为J1-J2类阻挫磁体在周期边界下的大规模模拟提供了高效、几乎无偏的途径，并可推广到其他阻挫自旋格子。

title: Instability-driven segregation of V group transition metals on HEB$_2$ grain boundaries influencing enhanced mechanical properties
summary: Five metals share a common sublattice in the (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B$_2$ (HEB$_2$). Most high-entropy materials are produced as polycrystalline materials in the form of sintered ceramics. The question of which metal species are located at grain boundaries is still unknown. Here, we calculated the grain-boundary energy $γ_{GB}$ of four types of boundaries in five binary diborides and HEB$_2$ using density functional theory (DFT). We analyzed the bonding at these boundaries using COHP and sampled cation segregation at six boundaries of HEB$_2$, ordered and general, using Monte Carlo / molecular dynamics with a MACE potential that was fine-tuned for this system. According to our results $γ_{GB}$ splits by group: the group V diborides NbB$_2$ and TaB$_2$ form boundaries with about half the energy of the group IV at three of the four types of GBs, ranging from 0.8 to 2.7 compared to 2.5--4.8~J/m$^2$. COHP shows a significant difference at the Fermi level, namely the Me--B bonds of NbB$_2$ and TaB$_2$ are antibonding at Fermi energy ($E_F$) in the bulk but bonding at the GB, while their integrated strength hardly changes. In HEB$_2$ the segregation follows a similar pattern: Nb and Ta are enriched at five of the six grain boundaries, including general boundaries, up to 23--35~at.\% at 2000~K, although the size of the atoms would favor Zr and Hf in the expanded sites. A segregated $Σ193$ grain boundary can withstand 26 against 20~GPa for a random boundary in tension at 300~K. The grain boundaries of HEB$_2$ are composed of group V metals, as suggested by the boundary energies of binaries compounds and their bonding at the Fermi level. Grain boundaries of the (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B$_2$ preferentially include Nb and Ta. This lowers the grain boundary energy and strengthens the boundaries. This consists of the lower boundary energy and changes Fermi level bonding in NbB$_2$ and TaB$_2$.

AI.tldr: DFT+COHP+MACE势蒙特卡洛研究表明，(Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B2高熵二硼化物晶界优先富集V族金属Nb和Ta，从而降低晶界能并强化晶界。
AI.motivation: 高熵材料多为烧结多晶陶瓷，晶界处究竟富集哪种金属物种尚不清楚，本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 用DFT计算五种二元二硼化物及HEB2中四类晶界的晶界能γGB，用COHP分析成键；再用针对该体系微调的MACE势进行Monte Carlo/Molecular Dynamics，对HEB2的六个晶界（有序与一般晶界）采样阳离子偏析；并进行拉伸模拟。
AI.result: γGB按族分裂：V族NbB2、TaB2在四类晶界中三类上的晶界能约为IV族的一半（0.8–2.7 vs 2.5–4.8 J/m²）。COHP显示NbB2、TaB2的Me–B键在体能带费米能处为反键、在晶界处为成键，但积分键强几乎不变。HEB2中Nb、Ta在六个晶界中的五个富集，2000 K下可达23–35 at.%，尽管尺寸因素本应偏向Zr、Hf。偏析后的Σ193晶界300 K拉伸强度为26 GPa，随机晶界为20 GPa。
AI.conclusion: HEB2晶界由V族金属构成，这与二元化合物晶界能及其费米能级成键一致；Nb、Ta优先进入晶界，降低晶界能并强化晶界。

title: Activating Nonstandard Axion Electrodynamics in Topological Insulator Materials
summary: The conventional axion response of topological insulators (TIs) is characterized by an isotropic pseudoscalar magnetoelectric (ME) coupling rooted in band topology: the condensed matter analog of the axion field. However, as we reveal here, this and other more general ME responses can arise in existing TI materials from symmetry breaking without requiring nontrivial topology. Indeed, we show that breaking parity and time-reversal symmetries using combined electric and magnetic fields unlocks nonstandard axion electrodynamics via the controllable activation of various tensorial ME couplings, thus, going beyond the standard axion picture. Using a well-established first-principles-informed effective model for Bi-and Sb-based TI materials, we estimate the resulting ME coefficients and make concrete predictions for experiments. In particular, we identify nonreciprocal directional dichroism as a distinctive magneto-optical signature of these ME effects, therefore opening a route to engineer and probe symmetry-induced ME phenomena beyond the conventional topological response.

AI.tldr: 该文指出拓扑绝缘体中各向同性赝标量轴子型磁电耦合并非唯一来源，打破宇称与时间反演对称性可在无拓扑贡献情况下激活张量型磁电耦合，并预测非互易方向二色性是其磁光特征。
AI.motivation: 传统认识将拓扑绝缘体的轴子响应归因于能带拓扑的各向同性赝标量磁电耦合，作者希望说明更一般的磁电响应可仅由对称性破缺产生，无需非平凡拓扑，从而拓展标准轴子图像。
AI.method: 基于Bi基与Sb基拓扑绝缘体成熟的第一性原理有效模型，通过同时施加电场与磁场打破宇称和时间反演对称性，系统激活并计算各类张量型磁电耦合系数，做出可实验检验的预言。
AI.result: 估算出相应的磁电系数，并识别出非互易方向二色性（nonreciprocal directional dichroism）作为这些磁电效应独特的磁光特征信号，可用于探测和区分其来源。
AI.conclusion: 磁电响应可由对称性破缺独立于拓扑产生，为工程化设计并探测超越常规拓扑响应之外的对称性诱导磁电现象提供了新途径。

title: NEP-kappa 2.0: A unified framework for phonon transport and nonequilibrium thermalization with machine-learning interatomic potentials
summary: We present NEP-kappa 2.0, a unified framework that integrates density-functional theory, material-specific machine-learning interatomic potentials, and pretrained force models for advanced phonon calculations. A common workflow enables harmonic lattice dynamics, quasi-harmonic and stochastic self-consistent phonon treatments, three- and four-phonon transport, Wigner population--coherence transport, and time-dependent phonon dynamics. Applications to 3C-SiC, BAs, and Cs$_2$AgInCl$_6$ demonstrate consistent force-model comparisons, finite-temperature renormalization, higher-order scattering, and intermode coherence. Beyond steady-state transport, mode-resolved simulations of selectively excited 3C-SiC reveal that half of the injected optical-phonon energy reaches acoustic modes within approximately 3.75 ps, primarily through one-optical--two-acoustic scattering. Acoustic branches exhibit response times differing by a factor of five, with competing scattering channels producing a transient energy overshoot. Channel-resolved entropy production and persistent nonthermal occupations distinguish interbranch energy redistribution from intrabranch thermalization. The framework connects equilibrium phonon transport with microscopic nonequilibrium energy dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架 NEP-kappa 2.0，整合DFT、材料专属机器学习势与预训练力模型，实现从谐/准谐/自洽声子到三/四声子输运、Wigner相干输运及含时声子动力学的多尺度声子计算。
AI.motivation: 现有声子计算方法分散于不同代码与近似层级，难以在同一工作流内对力模型、温度重整化、高阶散射与非平衡能量动力学进行一致比较。
AI.method: 构建通用工作流：DFT + 材料特定ML势 + 预训练力模型；支持简谐晶格动力学、准简谐与随机自洽声子、3/4声子输运、Wigner布居-相干输运、含时声子动力学；在3C-SiC、BAs、Cs2AgInCl6上验证，并对选择性激发的3C-SiC做模式分辨模拟。
AI.result: 三个体系的力模型比较、有限温重整化与高阶散射结果一致；3C-SiC中被注入光学声子能量约一半在~3.75 ps内经O→2A散射转移至声学支；不同声学支响应时间相差5倍，竞争散射通道导致瞬态能量过冲；通道分辨熵产生与非热占据可区分支间再分配与支内热化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将平衡态声子输运与微观非平衡能量动力学衔接起来，为统一描述声子热输运与瞬态能量弛豫提供平台。

title: Thermal Responses of Spin Density and Spin Current Induced by Bogoliubov Fermi Surfaces in Proximity Superconductors
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Published in Chinese Physics Letters
summary: The emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces in s-wave proximity superconducting systems provides a unique platform for generating nontrivial spin responses in the presence of spin-orbit coupling. In this work, we investigate temperature-gradient driven responses of spin polarization and spin current in such a proximity system related to Fe(Te,Se). The interplay of in-plane magnetization, superconductivity, and nematicity gives rise to nontrivial Berry curvature and spin-related hybrid Berry curvature on the Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, which are shown to lead to finite thermally driven nonequilibrium spin polarization and spin Nernst effect. We find that the responses are strongly enhanced by the emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, and are linear in temperature at low temperatures, rendering a unique spintronic character of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces.

AI.tldr: 研究s波近邻超导系统中Bogoliubov费米面（BFS）的温度梯度驱动自旋响应，发现BFS导致显著增强的热致自旋极化与自旋Nernst效应，且低温下线性依赖温度。
AI.motivation: BFS为自旋轨道耦合下产生非平凡自旋响应提供平台，但BFS相关的热驱动自旋输运性质尚不清楚，需探究其自旋电子学特征。
AI.method: 以Fe(Te,Se)相关近邻超导系统为对象，考虑面内磁化、超导与向列相的相互作用，计算BFS上非平凡Berry曲率及自旋相关杂化Berry曲率，分析温度梯度驱动的非平衡自旋极化和自旋Nernst效应。
AI.result: BFS产生非零热致非平衡自旋极化和自旋Nernst效应，响应被BFS显著增强，且低温下随温度线性变化。
AI.conclusion: Bogoliubov费米面具有独特的自旋电子学特性，可作为温度梯度驱动自旋响应的有效平台。

title: Generation of $N$-particle kappa-distributed velocities via superstatistical Gibbs sampling
summary: The \emph{kappa} distribution is widely used to model heavy-tailed, non-equilibrium velocity distributions in space and laboratory plasmas. Its correct use in particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations requires more than sampling the single-particle marginal: the $N$-particle \emph{kappa} distribution predicts non-trivial correlations between the kinetic energies of particles. Building on the superstatistical structure, we implement a Gibbs sampler whose stationary distribution is the joint distribution of the velocities and $β$, so that the sampled velocities follow the $N$-particle \emph{kappa} distribution and reproduce these correlations by construction.

AI.tldr: 本文指出PIC模拟中kappa分布不能仅靠采样单粒子边缘分布，而需再现N粒子kappa分布所蕴含的粒子动能间非平凡相关性，并提出基于超统计结构的Gibbs采样器来实现。
AI.motivation: kappa分布广泛用于描述空间与实验室等离子体中的重尾非平衡速度分布。现有PIC模拟只采样单粒子边缘分布，忽略了N粒子kappa分布预测的粒子动能相关结构，导致模拟物理不正确。
AI.method: 利用kappa分布的超统计（superstatistical）结构，构造一个以速度与β的联合分布为平稳分布的Gibbs采样器；采样得到的速度按构造即服从N粒子kappa分布并复现其相关性。
AI.result: 采样速度自动满足N粒子kappa分布，且动能间相关性由构造保证（摘要未给出定量数值结果）。
AI.conclusion: 该Gibbs采样方法为PIC模拟中正确使用kappa分布提供了可行途径，超越了单粒子边缘近似的局限。

title: Microscopic Compensation of Circular Optical Response in Altermagnets
summary: A weak or vanishing circular optical signal need not imply weak helicity-sensitive transitions: it can be the residual of much larger opposing microscopic contributions. We resolve the finite-frequency interband Kubo response before summing over transitions and momentum, separating cancellation among transitions at fixed momentum from cancellation across the Brillouin zone. An exactly compensated $d$-wave model establishes the symmetry benchmark. In MnTe, first-principles Wannier calculations reveal a symmetry-dark Néel orientation with an extended sign-changing circular kernel whose bulk integral vanishes. Reorienting the Néel vector removes this extinction, yet the allowed response remains a small imbalance between large positive- and negative-momentum sectors; the imbalance reverses with photon energy and flips the macroscopic sign. Thus magnetic symmetry decides whether circular response is allowed, whereas microscopic compensation determines how much survives and with what sign. This distinction provides a general framework for interpreting weak, vanishing, and sign-changing magneto-optical signals in compensated magnets.

AI.tldr: 弱或消失的圆偏振光信号并不意味着螺旋度敏感跃迁也弱，它可能是更大、相反的微观贡献相互抵消后的残余。文章在有限频率下解析带间Kubo响应，区分固定动量内跃迁抵消与布里渊区跨动量抵消，并用精确补偿的d波模型建立对标，再以第一性原理Wannier计算研究MnTe。
AI.motivation: 磁光圆响应常被直接当作螺旋度敏感跃迁强弱的判据，但在补偿磁体中总信号可能因微观贡献相互抵消而变弱或消失，容易导致对物理机制的误判。作者希望厘清"对称性允许与否"与"微观补偿导致多少信号存活"这两类不同问题。
AI.method: 将带间Kubo响应在求和之前按有限频率逐项解析，把抵消分解为固定动量处不同跃迁之间的抵消和布里渊区内跨动量的抵消；用具有精确补偿的d波模型作为对称性基准；对MnTe进行第一性原理Wannier计算，考察不同Néel取向下的圆响应核。
AI.result: MnTe中存在一种对称性"暗"的Néel取向，其圆响应核在扩展区域变号，体相积分恰好为零。改变Néel矢量取向后该消光被解除，但允许的响应仍是大的正、负动量扇区之间的小幅不平衡；该不平衡随光子能量反转，并使宏观符号翻转。
AI.conclusion: 磁对称性决定圆响应是否被允许，而微观补偿决定有多少信号存活及其符号。该区分框架可用于解释补偿磁体中弱、消失及变号的磁光信号。

title: Chiral symmetry and the orbital susceptibility of disordered honeycomb flakes
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material: 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: The orbital susceptibility of a small disordered grain is dominated by rare samples in which an occupied and an empty level nearly touch. In a chaotic grain such near-degeneracies are suppressed by level repulsion and must also coincide with the chemical potential, so the mean susceptibility stays finite. In a neutral honeycomb flake, chiral (sublattice) symmetry removes the second condition: It places the chemical potential in the middle of the smallest gap, in every disorder realization. Here we show that the mean orbital susceptibility then grows as $\ln(1/T)$ at low temperature $T$ if disorder can close this gap while a magnetic field still mixes the two levels, and that the hopping geometry decides whether it can: Positive nearest-neighbor hopping on a compact hexagonal flake keeps the gap open, third-neighbor hopping allows it to close. In a chiral random-matrix model with $n$ level pairs the coefficient of the logarithm is $C_n=\sqrt{2/n}\,Γ[(n+1)/2]/Γ(n/2)$, close to unity, and a detuned chemical potential cuts the logarithm off.

AI.tldr: 在保持手征对称性的中性蜂窝状小颗粒中，轨道磁化率低温下呈 ln(1/T) 发散，其能否出现取决于跃迁几何，并可被化学势失谐截断。
AI.motivation: 小无序颗粒的轨道磁化率由"占据态与空态几乎相触"的稀有样品主导；混沌颗粒中能级排斥使近简并受抑制且须与化学势重合，故平均磁化率有限。作者想考察手征对称性可消除"须对齐化学势"这一条件的情形。
AI.method: 围绕中性蜂窝状（honeycomb）薄片，结合手征对称性论证与手征随机矩阵模型（n 对能级）解析计算近简并对磁化率的贡献，并比较不同跃迁几何（最近邻与第三近邻跃迁）对能隙是否被关闭的影响。
AI.result: 若无序能关闭该能隙而磁场仍能混合这两能级，则平均轨道磁化率随温度 T 按 ln(1/T) 增长；紧凑六边形薄片上的正最近邻跃迁保持能隙打开，而第三近邻跃迁可使其关闭。手征随机矩阵模型中 ln 的系数为 C_n=√(2/n)Γ[(n+1)/2]/Γ(n/2)，接近 1；化学势失谐会截断该对数。
AI.conclusion: 手征对称性把化学势钉在最小能隙中央，使近简并对的混合成为对数磁化率发散的关键机制；该发散存在与否由跃迁几何决定，且可通过化学势失谐加以调控（截断）。

title: Engineering topological phenomena via field-driven Weyl motion
summary: We illustrate the field-driven anomalous Hall engineering via the momentum-space motion of Weyl nodes using pyrochlore iridates under a [111] magnetic field as an example. We model the system with a well-established microscopic Hamiltonian and the field effect with the spin rotation from the all-in-all-out to the ferromagnetic state. Tracking the position of Weyl nodes during the spin rotation, we demonstrate macroscopic anomalous Hall conductivity variations are fundamentally driven by Weyl node motions by comparing the full multi-band Kubo formula with the geometric Weyl node separation. The discrepancy occurs only near a critical spin rotation angle, where several Weyl nodes come into close proximity. We reveal that the evolution of anomalous Hall conductivity under the magnetic field agrees with reported experiments in an order-of-magnitude and non-monotonicity. These results elucidate the field-driven dynamics of momentum-space monopoles and provide a framework for understanding transport in strongly correlated topological materials.

AI.tldr: 以烧绿石铱氧化物在[111]磁场下为例，揭示磁场驱动的自旋旋转使外尔节点在动量空间移动，从而主导反常霍尔电导的变化。
AI.motivation: 希望理解强关联拓扑材料中磁场如何通过动量空间磁单极（外尔节点）的运动来调控反常霍尔效应，并解释实验中反常霍尔电导的非单调行为。
AI.method: 采用成熟的微观哈密顿量建模，将磁场效应用从all-in-all-out到铁磁态的自旋旋转描述；追踪自旋旋转过程中外尔节点的位置，并将完整多带Kubo公式结果与几何外尔节点分离度进行比较。
AI.result: 宏观反常霍尔电导的变化本质上由外尔节点运动驱动；仅当自旋旋转接近临界角、多个外尔节点相互靠近时，Kubo公式与几何分离度描述才出现偏差；所得磁场下反常霍尔电导的量级与非单调性与已报道实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 阐明了动量空间磁单极的场驱动动力学，为理解强关联拓扑材料中的输运提供了框架。

title: Autonomous adaptive spectral analysis with an LLM agent for self-driving laboratories
summary: Self-driving laboratories accelerate materials exploration through autonomous closed-loop integration of synthesis, characterization, and next-experiment selection. However, characterization does not always directly provide the target property; measured spectra or images often require automated analysis to extract quantitative descriptors based on physically motivated assumptions and predefined criteria. Such procedures can fail for measurements outside these criteria, requiring a decision on whether a reliable value can be recovered or no numerical value should be reported. Here, we implemented an autonomous adaptive spectral-analysis agent using a large language model (LLM) to supervise a deterministic numerical-analysis routine. For each spectrum, the agent executes the predefined analysis script and assesses the result using the measured spectrum and fitting diagnostics. Valid results are accepted unchanged, recoverable failures are reanalyzed through bounded adjustments of predefined fitting parameters, and NaN (not a number) is returned when no scientifically defensible value can be obtained. We evaluated the workflow on optical transmittance spectra from 203 epitaxial beta-Ga2O3 films grown during a previously reported self-driving thin-film growth campaign. The predefined optical analysis script returned Urbach energy, an optical-quality metric, for 183 spectra and failed for 20. The agent retained those 183 values and evaluated 20 exception cases, recovering 16 through bounded parameter adjustments and returning NaN for 4 when the spectral evidence did not support a reliable Urbach tail. The audit records captured spectral features, parameter changes, and rationale for each decision. These results demonstrate autonomous scientific exception handling by an LLM agent while leaving quantitative property extraction to deterministic numerical analysis.

AI.tldr: 将大语言模型(LLM)作为监督者，协调确定性数值分析脚本，实现光谱分析中的自主异常处理：可靠结果直接接受、可恢复失败通过有界参数调整重分析、无法获得科学可靠值时返回NaN。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室中，表征谱或图像常需自动化分析提取定量描述符，但基于物理假设和预设准则的固定流程在超出准则的测量上会失败，需要判断能否恢复可靠数值或应报告无值。
AI.method: 构建基于LLM的自适应光谱分析智能体，监督确定性数值分析例程。对每条光谱执行预定义分析脚本，结合实测光谱与拟合诊断评估结果：有效结果原样接受；可恢复失败通过有界调整预定义拟合参数重新分析；不可靠时返回NaN。并在203个β-Ga2O3外延薄膜光学透射谱上评估（来自既往自驱动薄膜生长实验）。
AI.result: 预定义脚本为183条光谱返回Urbach能量，20条失败。智能体保留183个值，对20个异常案例中16个通过有界参数调整成功恢复，4个因光谱证据不支持可靠Urbach尾而返回NaN。审计记录捕获了光谱特征、参数变化和每次决策的理由。
AI.conclusion: 结果展示了LLM智能体进行自主科学异常处理的能力，同时将定量属性提取保留给确定性数值分析，兼顾灵活性与可审计性。

title: Categorical classification of non-Fermi liquids in 2+1 dimensions
summary: A defining feature of non-Fermi liquids is a lack of the quasiparticle peak on the Fermi surface in the spectral function, which is usually realized by coupling a finite density of fermions with critical collective fluctuations. However, these features of the two- and three-point vertex functions are qualitatively the same across many non-Fermi liquids, which has made it difficult to classify them beyond the definition by negation. We point out that the four-point function in the pairing channel contains rich information that positively differentiates distinct types of non-Fermi liquids. Using the generalized notion of fixed points that captures scale-dependent universal pairing interaction, we provide a non-perturbative classification of 2+1-dimensional non-Fermi liquids. In the large Fermi momentum limit with fixed dimensionless couplings, metals coupled with long-wavelength critical fluctuations are classified into seven superuniversality classes. Each of them exhibits a unique phase diagram in the space of temperature and bare four-fermion coupling. The present work generalizes the earlier perturbative classification to strongly interacting non-Fermi liquids by leveraging kinematic constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文利用配对通道四点函数对2+1维非费米液体做非微扰分类，将长波长临界涨落耦合的金属划分为七个"超普适类"，每类具有独特温度-裸耦合相图。
AI.motivation: 非费米液体的定义是费米面上缺乏准粒子峰，但其二点、三点顶点函数在不同非费米液体间定性相似，难以做"否定式定义"之外的分类，故需寻找能正向区分不同类型非费米液体的观测量。
AI.method: 指出配对通道四点函数包含丰富的区分信息；采用捕捉尺度依赖普适配对相互作用的广义不动点概念，结合运动学约束，对大费米动量极限下（固定无量纲耦合）与长波长临界涨落耦合的金属进行非微扰分类。
AI.result: 将所有此类非费米液体归入七个超普适类，每类在温度与裸四费米子耦合空间中有独特相图；并把先前微扰分类推广到强相互作用情形。
AI.conclusion: 配对通道四点函数提供了正向区分非费米液体的新途径，广义不动点方法借助运动学约束实现了非微扰分类，为超越"否定式定义"的非费米液体分类体系奠定基础。

title: Crystal Structure Based Graph Neural Network And LLM Multi-Modal Approach for Material Magnetic Ordering Prediction
summary: AI/ML models are useful for the prediction of materials' properties. Recently, there has been great progress in developing Neural Network models to predict the properties of solids, molecules, and crystals, avoiding expensive and time-consuming laboratory testing. This study presents a novel AI/ML-based multi-modal approach to predict material magnetic ordering using material crystal structure information as input to a Graph Neural Network model (GNN) and semantic text descriptions of the material's properties and structure as input to a Large Language Model (LLM), before performing information fusion of the GNN and LLM outputs to predict material magnetic ordering in four classes (Non-magnetic, Ferromagnetic, Antiferromagnetic, Ferrimagnetic). The model is trained, validated, and tested on a dataset which is a combination of Materials Project dataset, Magndata dataset, and a set of uranium compounds with magnetic ordering determined in laboratory testing, with an 80/10/10 (training/validation/testing) data split. The proposed GNN and LLM multi-modal approach achieves better overall accuracy than both the standalone GNN and LLM approaches with three fusion strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种融合图神经网络(GNN，输入晶体结构)与大语言模型(LLM，输入材料性质与结构的语义文本描述)的多模态AI方法，用于预测材料的磁有序类别（非磁、铁磁、反铁磁、亚铁磁）。
AI.motivation: 用AI/ML预测固体、分子和晶体的性质可避免昂贵耗时的实验室测试，已有神经网络模型取得进展，但单一模态（仅结构或仅文本）信息利用不充分，因此希望结合结构图信息与语义文本信息提升磁有序预测性能。
AI.method: 构建GNN对晶体结构建模、LLM对材料性质与结构的语义文本描述建模，并将二者输出进行信息融合（比较三种融合策略），实现四类磁有序分类。数据集由Materials Project、Magndata及一组实验室测定磁有序的铀化合物合并而成，按80/10/10划分训练/验证/测试。
AI.result: 在三种融合策略下，GNN+LLM多模态方法的整体准确率均优于单独使用GNN或单独使用LLM的方法。
AI.conclusion: 多模态GNN-LLM融合可有效提升材料磁有序预测精度，优于单一模态基线。

title: Effects of Nonmagnetic Impurities on Nonequilibrium Phase Transitions in Microwave-Driven Superconductors
summary: We investigate the nonequilibrium steady states of a microwave-driven BCS superconductor in the presence of nonmagnetic impurity scattering and energy relaxation. Using the Floquet-Nambu-Keldysh Green's function method together with the self-consistent Born approximation, we self-consistently determine the superconducting order parameter in the microwave-driven steady state. We find that the nonequilibrium phase diagram depends strongly on the impurity-scattering strength. When impurity scattering is absent or weak, the steady-state order parameter is single-valued at each temperature and drive frequency. At intermediate scattering strengths, we find bistability between microwave-enhanced and microwave-suppressed superconducting states. As the impurity-scattering strength increases further, we instead find bistability between the superconducting and normal states. This evolution reflects competition between two effects of microwave driving: Eliashberg-type enhancement through the redistribution of thermally excited quasiparticles and suppression through pair-breaking-induced quasiparticle generation. In contrast to the robustness of equilibrium $s$-wave superconductivity against nonmagnetic impurity scattering, our results demonstrate that nonmagnetic impurity scattering plays a central role in determining the character of nonequilibrium superconducting phase transitions under microwave driving.

AI.tldr: 用Floquet-Nambu-Keldysh格林函数结合自洽Born近似，研究微波驱动BCS超导体在非磁杂质散射与能量弛豫下的非平衡稳态，发现相图强烈依赖杂质散射强度：弱散射时序参量单值，中等散射出现"微波增强/抑制"双稳，强散射出现"超导/正常"双稳。
AI.motivation: 平衡态s波超导对非磁杂质散射具有鲁棒性（Anderson定理），但微波驱动下非平衡超导相变是否仍如此尚不清楚，需明确杂质散射与能量弛豫在非平衡稳态相图中的作用。
AI.method: 采用Floquet-Nambu-Keldysh格林函数方法，配合自洽Born近似处理非磁杂质散射，并计入能量弛豫，自洽求解微波驱动稳态下的超导序参量，构建非平衡相图。
AI.result: 非平衡相图强烈依赖杂质散射强度：无杂质或弱散射时各温度与驱动频率下序参量单值；中等散射强度下出现微波增强态与微波抑制态之间的双稳；散射进一步增强时变为超导态与正常态之间的双稳。
AI.conclusion: 该演化源于微波驱动两种效应的竞争：通过热激发准粒子重分布的Eliashberg型增强，与对破配对产生准粒子的抑制效应。与平衡态s波超导对非磁杂质不敏感不同，非磁杂质散射在决定微波驱动下非平衡超导相变性质中起核心作用。

title: Phase transitions of the antiferromagnetic $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_3$ Ising model on the cubic lattice
summary: Motivated by the conflicting findings in prior studies regarding the nature of the phase transition for the three-dimensional antiferromagnetic $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_3$ Ising model on the cubic lattice with $J_1 = J_2 = J_3 = 1.0$, in this study we conduct a detailed investigation of this model using both Monte Carlo simulations and neural networks (NN). Here $J_1$ and $J_2$ are the intralayer nearest-neighbor and next-nearest-neighbor couplings, respectively, and $J_3$ is the nearest-neighbor interlayer interaction. By investigating the data obtained from much larger lattices than those used in previous studies, we find that the phase transition for $J_1 = J_2 = J_3 = 1.0$ is second order without any ambiguity. Hence we bring a resolution to this debate. Apart from $J_1 = J_2 = J_3 = 1.0$, we study the critical phenomenon associated with $J_2/J_1 = 4/7$ and $J_3 = J_1 = 1.0$ as well. In addition, by employing a dedicated training and testing strategy, our NN computation not only is much more efficient than those utilizing the standard procedures commonly used in the literature, but also requires only a per-mille fraction of the storage capacity needed by a conventional NN calculation when a large linear system size $L$ is considered. The method employed here provides an extremely resource-efficient route for applying NN techniques to study the critical behaviors of higher-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 通过更大尺寸格点的蒙特卡洛与神经网络计算，确认三维反铁磁 J1-J2-J3 伊辛模型在 J1=J2=J3=1.0 时的相变为二级相变，并研究了 J2/J1=4/7 的临界现象，同时提出一种高效节省存储的神经网络训练测试策略。
AI.motivation: 此前关于立方格点上三维反铁磁 J1-J2-J3 伊辛模型（J1=J2=J3=1.0）相变性质的结论相互矛盾，亟需澄清；同时将神经网络应用于高维系统临界行为研究存在资源消耗大的问题。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟与神经网络两种方法，使用比以往研究大得多的格点尺寸生成数据；并设计专用的训练与测试策略以提升神经网络计算效率并降低存储需求；另外考察 J2/J1=4/7、J3=J1=1.0 的临界现象。
AI.result: J1=J2=J3=1.0 时的相变明确为二级相变，从而解决了相关争论；所提神经网络方案效率显著高于文献常用流程，且在大线性尺寸 L 下仅需传统方法千分之一量级的存储容量。
AI.conclusion: 研究澄清了该模型相变性质的争议，并提供了一条极为节省资源、可将神经网络技术推广到高维系统临界行为研究的途径。

title: A Stress-Induced Tetragonal Distortion in K2OsCl6 under Pressure
summary: The structural behaviour of cubic (Fm-3m) K2OsCl6 under compression was investigated to 35.4 GPa using angle-dispersive synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction. Upon increasing pressure, K2OsCl6 undergoes a sequence of structural transformations from the ambient-pressure cubic phase to a tetragonal (P4/mnc) phase above 9.5(3) GPa, followed by a transition to a monoclinic (P21/n) phase beginning at approximately 14.2 GPa. The tetragonal and monoclinic phases coexist over the pressure range 14.2-17.2 GPa, while the monoclinic phase is observed as the sole phase at 17.9 GPa and remains stable up to the maximum pressure investigated. Analysis of the diffraction profiles and unit-cell parameters indicates that the intermediate tetragonal structure is likely associated with stress-induced symmetry lowering rather than a distinct thermodynamic phase. This distortion, which is adequately described by the tetragonal P4/mnc space group, is attributed to non-hydrostatic deviatoric stresses arising from the pressure-transmitting medium. Equation-of-state analysis reveals a pronounced reduction in compressibility across the structural transitions, with the bulk modulus increasing from 26(2) GPa for the cubic phase to 71(3) GPa for the monoclinic phase. The pressure-induced structural sequence is analogous to that reported for related compounds such as K2IrCl6, although the transitions in K2OsCl6 occur at lower pressures. All structural transformations are reversible upon decompression.

AI.tldr: 研究K2OsCl6在35.4 GPa内的压缩行为：立方Fm-3m相经四方P4/mnc（>9.5 GPa，疑为应力诱导）转为单斜P21/n（~14.2 GPa起），体积模量由26 GPa增至71 GPa，相变可逆。
AI.motivation: 探究立方双钙钛矿类卤化物K2OsCl6在高压下的结构稳定性与压缩行为，并与K2IrCl6等相关化合物对比，理解压力诱导结构序列与压缩性变化。
AI.method: 采用角散同步辐射粉末X射线衍射，加压至35.4 GPa；分析衍射谱与晶胞参数，进行状态方程（EOS）拟合以获取体积模量。
AI.result: 9.5(3) GPa以上出现四方P4/mnc相，约14.2 GPa起转变为单斜P21/n相；两相在14.2–17.2 GPa共存，17.9 GPa后单斜相单独稳定至最高压力。四方相可能源于压传介质引起的非静水偏应力而非独立热力学相。体积模量从立方相26(2) GPa升至单斜相71(3) GPa，压缩性显著降低。
AI.conclusion: K2OsCl6的结构序列与K2IrCl6类似但相变压力更低；所有结构转变在卸压后可逆。

title: Ferroelastic domain wall driven glassy dynamics and photoresponse in a SrTiO$_3$ (111) two-dimensional electron gas
summary: The (111) orientation of SrTiO$_3$ (STO)-based heterostructures has emerged as a versatile platform for two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs), yet the influence of STO's polar ferroelastic domain-wall (DW) network on charge transport remains largely unexplored. Here we study AlO$_x$/STO (111) interfaces hosting 2DEGs of different carrier densities. In the lower-density 2DEG, low-temperature transport exhibits thermal hysteresis, slow resistance relaxation, cooling-rate dependence, and memory effects, signaling glasslike electron dynamics. The relaxation is strongly non-monotonic in temperature, increasing below $\sim$80 K, peaking near 25 K, and vanishing below $\sim$12 K, tracking the established evolution of the ferroelastic DW state of bulk STO rather than any electronic energy scale, which identifies the DW network as its origin. These signatures are absent in a second, more metallic interface with much higher carrier density, demonstrating that the electron-DW coupling can be tuned. We further show that polar DWs govern the photoresponse: the persistent photoconductivity rises sharply below $\sim$80 K, coinciding with the onset of DW polarity. Together, these results establish polar ferroelastic DWs as a carrier-density-tunable electronic degree of freedom in STO (111)-based 2DEGs, opening routes to manipulate 2DEG properties through topological defects.

AI.tldr: AlOx/STO(111)界面的二维电子气中，低温输运出现玻璃态电子动力学，其非单调温度依赖与STO体材料极性铁弹畴壁网络的演化一致，表明畴壁是起源；该耦合可通过载流子密度调控。
AI.motivation: STO(111)基异质结是二维电子气的热门平台，但其极性铁弹畴壁网络对电荷输运的影响几乎未被研究。
AI.method: 制备不同载流子密度的AlOx/STO(111)界面2DEG，开展低温输运测量（热滞回、电阻弛豫、降温速率依赖、记忆效应）并研究持续光电导。
AI.result: 低密度2DEG呈玻璃态电子动力学：弛豫在~80 K以下增强、25 K附近达峰、12 K以下消失，与畴壁态演化而非电子能标一致；高密度金属性界面无此特征；持续光电导在~80 K以下（畴壁极性出现处）陡增。
AI.conclusion: 极性铁弹畴壁是STO(111)基2DEG中可由载流子密度调控的电子自由度，可通过拓扑缺陷操控2DEG性质。

title: Interfacial origin of magnetic compensation and topological-like Hall effect in crystalline lutetium iron garnet thin films.
summary: Ferrimagnetic oxides such as rare-earth iron garnets (REIG) have emerged as essential components of spin-based devices owing to their high Curie temperatures, low Gilbert damping, and excellent insulating properties. Recently, REIGs have attracted immense interest for hosting robust chiral spin textures that can be potential information carriers in next-generation spintronic devices. Here we investigate the structural, chemical, and magnetic behaviour of single-crystal Lu3Fe5O12 (LuIG) thin films for different film thicknesses on a Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111) or SGGG(111) substrate. Our results demonstrate the presence of a 3 nm-thick Gd-rich LuIG layer at the LuIG/SGGG interface, which gives rise to a magnetic compensation temperature around 50 K. We further probe the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in LuIG layers with an adjacent platinum ultrathin film. In addition to the magnetic compensation point, the AHE loops show pronounced nonmonotonic features, often attributed to the spin Hall topological-like Hall effect (SH-THE) and non-collinear spin textures arising from the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI). LuIG thickness-dependent AHE measurements reveal that the composition variation due to Gd diffusion breaks the inversion symmetry and could contribute to DMI. These findings shed light on fundamental understanding and engineering of the different interfaces of magnetic garnets for advanced spintronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 该文研究不同厚度Lu3Fe5O12(LuIG)单晶薄膜在SGGG(111)衬底上的结构、化学与磁性，发现界面处存在3 nm厚富Gd层导致约50 K磁补偿温度，并在LuIG/Pt体系中观察到异常霍尔效应的非单调特征，指出Gd扩散引起的成分变化可破坏反演对称性并贡献DMI。
AI.motivation: 稀土铁石榴石(REIG)因高居里温度、低Gilbert阻尼和优良绝缘性而成为自旋器件关键材料，其承载的手性自旋纹理有望作为下一代自旋电子器件的信息载体；但薄膜/衬底界面效应对磁性和输运行为的影响尚需深入理解。
AI.method: 在Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111)(SGGG)衬底上生长不同厚度的LuIG单晶薄膜，结合结构、化学与磁性表征；并在LuIG上覆盖超薄Pt层测量异常霍尔效应(AHE)，进行厚度依赖的AHE测量以关联界面成分与自旋织构。
AI.result: 在LuIG/SGGG界面发现约3 nm厚的富Gd LuIG层，产生约50 K的磁补偿温度；LuIG/Pt的AHE回线除磁补偿点外还表现出明显的非单调特征，通常归因于自旋霍尔类拓扑霍尔效应(SH-THE)及DMI诱导的非共线自旋纹理；厚度依赖AHE表明Gd扩散造成的成分变化破坏反演对称性，可能贡献DMI。
AI.conclusion: 界面Gd扩散深刻影响LuIG薄膜的磁补偿与自旋输运行为，为磁性石榴石异质界面的基础理解与工程调控提供了依据，有利于先进自旋电子器件应用。

title: Methods of density functional theory in one dimension
summary: Density functional theory is formally justified by an existence proof. As such, the need for computational methods to study the theory is a useful route to understanding the full theory. In this paper, we discuss the numerical strategies to efficiently evaluate computations for Kohn-Sham systems in one dimension and also methods for determining exact properties, including time-dependence. An accompanying library is also available for computing one-dimensional density functional theory and publicly available. The expressions used to implement the density functional in one-dimension are surveyed. An alternative justification for a gradient-based technique is also shown that can be applied to time-dependent evolution of the exact Kohn-Sham potential.

AI.tldr: 该论文讨论一维Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论的高效数值计算策略，并给出求解精确性质（含时间依赖）的方法，同时公开一个配套的一维DFT计算库。
AI.motivation: DFT仅由存在性证明来确立其理论正当性，缺乏构造性表达，因此借助计算方法来研究和理解完整理论是一条有价值的途径。
AI.method: 系统梳理一维密度泛函的实现表达式，设计用于一维Kohn-Sham体系高效数值求解的策略，并对梯度类技术给出一种新的论证，使其可应用于精确Kohn-Sham势的时间演化。
AI.result: 提供了一维DFT数值计算与精确性质（含时间依赖）求解的方法，并发布了可公开获取的配套计算库。
AI.conclusion: 计算方法可作为理解DFT理论的有效手段；一维情形为理论与数值验证提供了可行且开放的研究平台。

title: Phase engineering of odd parity state in a quantum dot Josephson junction
summary: Controlling fermion parity in quantum-dot Josephson junctions (QDJJs) enables access to novel superconducting physics. While parity transitions are usually tuned electrically, we study phase-induced transitions in a strongly coupled QDJJ using the superconducting phase difference across the dot terminals, denoted by $φ$. We find that this phase allows control over the ground state parity, with parity transitions observed as the Andreev bound states (ABSs) energies crossing zero. These crossings occur near $φ= π$, and their behavior is in good correspondence to a simple model considering a single-level quantum dot proximitized by a superconductor. These results place phase-controlled QDJJ arrays as a promising platform for exploring exotic phenomena such as Majorana zero modes.

AI.tldr: 利用超导相位差φ调控强耦合量子点约瑟夫森结基态费米子宇称，在φ≈π处观察到Andreev束缚态能量过零导致的宇称跃迁，与单能级近邻化模型吻合。
AI.motivation: 量子点约瑟夫森结中费米子宇称通常通过电学门压调节，而相位驱动的宇称跃迁研究较少，其机制与可控性尚不明确；理解相位对基态宇称的调控有助于探索马约拉纳零模等新奇超导物理。
AI.method: 在强耦合量子点约瑟夫森结中，通过改变量子点两端超导相位差φ来调谐体系，测量Andreev束缚态（ABS）能谱随φ的演化，以ABS能量过零作为宇称跃迁的判据，并与考虑单个能级被超导近邻化的简化模型进行对比。
AI.result: 发现相位差φ可控制基态宇称，宇称跃迁表现为ABS能量过零，且这些过零发生在φ≈π附近；实验行为与单能级近邻化量子点模型符合良好。
AI.conclusion: 相位可作为一种有效调控量子点约瑟夫森结基态宇称的手段，相位控制的QDJJ阵列有望成为研究马约拉纳零模等奇异现象的平台。

title: Gini coefficient of scientists and universities
comment: 23 pages + 8 SuppMat pages, 11 main figures, 7 Appendix figures and 23 SuppMat figures
summary: Using the public database of Google Scholar article citations of scientists and universities we apply the algorithm for constructing Lorenz curves to the resulting citation distributions. Using Lorenz and Pareto curves, broadly used for economic analyses of wealth inequality across countries, we show that this approach gives a useful insight of citation distributions of world-leading scientists characterized by the Gini coefficient $G$ obtained from the Lorenz curves. For articles of 15 Nobel laureates (including A. Einstein and R. Feynman) we find the average $G=0.81$ with 50% of articles capturing only 2.7% of all citations and the top 10% (1%) of articles capturing 71% (30%) of all citations. Furthmore, we determine for world-leading universities the Gini coefficient via the citations of affiliated scientists. We show that about 65 percent of all citations belonging to a university (e.g. Princeton, Cambridge) are generated only by 10 percent of their university scientists while 50% of scientists produce only 3% of all university citations. The citation distributions are well described by the concept of Rayleigh-Jeans thermalization and condensation with similarities traced to the world wealth inequality.

AI.tldr: 该文用洛伦兹曲线与基尼系数分析科学家和大学的引用分布，发现引用高度不平等（顶级科学家G≈0.81），并借用Rayleigh-Jeans热化与凝聚概念加以解释。
AI.motivation: 借用经济学中衡量财富不平等的洛伦兹曲线/帕累托曲线与基尼系数，为科学家及大学的引用分布不平等提供直观、可比较的定量刻画，并探索其与财富不平等的类比。
AI.method: 基于Google Scholar公开的科学家与大学论文引用数据库，对引用分布构建洛伦兹曲线并计算基尼系数；对15位诺贝尔奖得主（含爱因斯坦、费曼）逐篇统计引用份额；对世界领先大学通过其附属科学家的引用计算基尼系数；并用Rayleigh-Jeans热化与凝聚模型拟合引用分布。
AI.result: 15位诺奖得主平均G=0.81；50%的论文仅占总引用的2.7%，前10%（1%）论文占71%（30%）。顶尖大学中约65%的引用由10%的科学家产生，50%的科学家仅贡献约3%的引用。引用分布可被Rayleigh-Jeans热化与凝聚很好地描述，并与世界财富不平等相似。
AI.conclusion: 洛伦兹/基尼分析能有效揭示科研引用系统中的极端不平等；引用分布呈现类热化—凝聚特征，与财富不平等具有可比性，为科研评价与不平等研究提供新视角。

title: Magnetoelectric Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Solids
summary: It is commonly believed that a bulk photovoltaic current requires broken spatial inversion symmetry. However, in this work, we demonstrate that dc photocurrents can arise in centrosymmetric solids from the bilinear coupling between the electric and magnetic components of light. This magnetoelectric bulk photovoltaic effect (MBPE) has a quantum-geometric origin in the dipole moments of the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature. We identify four distinct MBPE mechanisms, including time-reversal-even and time-reversal-odd injection-like and shift-like photocurrents driven by linearly or circularly polarized light. Our symmetry analysis shows that the MBPE is allowed in broad classes of two-dimensional centrosymmetric nonmagnetic and magnetic materials under normally incident light. As representative examples, we predict sizable MBPEs in centrosymmetric monolayer Pt$_2$HgSe$_3$ and altermagnetic RuF$_4$, with current densities on the order of $1~\mathrm{mA/m}$. Notably, the injection-like photocurrent in RuF$_4$ reverses sign upon switching either the light helicity or the Néel vector. Our results extend the bulk photovoltaic effect to centrosymmetric solids and open new opportunities for electrical readout of altermagnetic order.

AI.tldr: 该文证明中心对称固体中也能产生直流光电流，其来源是光电场与磁场的双线性耦合，称为磁电体光伏效应（MBPE），并提出其量子几何起源与四种机制，在单层Pt2HgSe3和交错磁体RuF4中预言了可观测效应。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为体光伏电流需要空间反演对称性破缺，因此中心对称材料中长期被认为不可能产生直流光电流，这限制了可用的材料范围。作者希望突破这一限制，并探索与新物性（如交错磁序）结合的光电响应。
AI.method: 从理论上考虑光场电场分量与磁场分量的双线性耦合，推导出由Zeeman量子度规和Zeeman贝里曲率的偶极矩（量子几何量）描述的磁电体光伏效应；区分出时间反演偶/奇的注入型与位移型共四种机制，对应线偏振或圆偏振光；并进行对称性分析以确定哪些二维中心对称非磁与磁性材料允许该效应，随后用第一性原理计算单层Pt2HgSe3与交错磁体RuF4进行验证。
AI.result: MBPE在大量二维中心对称非磁性与磁性材料中在正入射下是被对称性允许的；在Pt2HgSe3和RuF4中预言了约1 mA/m量级的电流密度；RuF4中的注入型光电流在切换光螺旋度或Néel矢量时符号反转。
AI.conclusion: 将体光伏效应推广到中心对称固体，并提出一种电学读出交错磁序（Néel矢量）的新途径。

title: Generalised Fluctuating Dynamic Density-Functional Theory: Derivation and Applications
summary: Classical density-functional theory is a powerful theoretical framework for studying the equilibrium density distribution of complex many-body systems. The core of the framework is to bridge microscopic and macroscopic descriptions of fluids through a variational principle that minimises the system's free energy. For dynamical settings, dynamic DFT (DDFT) extends the equilibrium framework to capture the time evolution of an order parameter, typically density. However, DDFT is often insufficient for mesoscopic systems far from equilibrium where fluctuations become significant, necessitating a stochastic extension: fluctuating DDFT. Here we derive a generalised FDDFT from first principles starting from the microscopic Hamiltonian dynamics using coarse-graining techniques, including Zwanzig's projection operator method. The resulting FDDFT applies to arbitrary observable fields, where the dynamics are driven by a thermodynamic force expressed in terms of an entropy functional. The dynamics consist of reversible, dissipative, and stochastic contributions, each directly linked to the underlying microscopic dynamics via the Liouville operator, Green-Kubo relations, and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. To highlight the difference in the level of description between DDFT and FDDFT, we demonstrate how further coarse-graining via averaging leads to a generalised DDFT, valid at the macroscale. To showcase the effectiveness and utility of the generalised FDDFT, we apply it to two prototypical fluid systems: colloidal and simple viscous fluids. In the former case, we utilise the new formalism to re-derive the recently found colloidal FDDFT. In the latter case, we rigorously recover the non-isothermal extension of the Landau-Lifshitz fluctuating Navier-Stokes equations, providing fundamental derivation of this well-known phenomenological model, enabling to clarify its underlying principles.

AI.tldr: 该文从微观哈密顿动力学出发，用Zwanzig投影算符等粗粒化方法，推导出适用于任意可观测量场的广义涨落动态密度泛函理论（FDDFT），并展示了其与DDFT及宏观模型的关系。
AI.motivation: 经典DFT与动态DFT（DDFT）可描述平衡与近平衡体系，但对远离平衡、涨落显著的介观体系不足，需要涨落扩展（FDDFT）。现有FDDFT缺乏从第一性原理出发的一般性推导。
AI.method: 以微观哈密顿动力学为起点，采用粗粒化技术（含Zwanzig投影算符方法）推导广义FDDFT；动力学由熵泛函给出的热力学力驱动，包含可逆、耗散与随机三部分，分别通过Liouville算符、Green-Kubo关系与涨落耗散定理与微观动力学联系；再通过平均进一步粗粒化得到宏观广义DDFT。
AI.result: 得到适用于任意可观测量场的广义FDDFT框架；对胶体体系重新导出已有的胶体FDDFT，对简单黏性流体严格恢复非等温Landau-Lifshitz涨落Navier-Stokes方程，从而为该唯象模型提供基础性推导并澄清其原理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从微观动力学到介观涨落密度泛函理论的统一第一性原理框架，厘清了DDFT与FDDFT的描述层级差异，并为已知唯象涨落流体力学模型提供微观依据，具有广泛适用性。

title: Evidence of valence bond solid and quantum paramagnetism in the $J_1$--$J_2$--$J_3$ Heisenberg model from pseudofermion functional renormalization group
summary: Motivated by recent tensor network studies reporting a quantum spin liquid (QSL) within the quantum paramagnetic (QP) regime, we investigate numerically the zero-temperature phase diagram of the $J_1$--$J_2$--$J_3$ Heisenberg model on the square lattice using the pseudofermion functional renormalization group (pf-fRG). Thanks to improved frequency resolution and larger lattice truncations, we are able to explore a significantly larger parameter space than previous pf-fRG work to map out the phase boundary of an extended QP region. We further resolve possible bond order within the QP regime by measuring the dimer response to small deformations in $J_1$, i.e. bond anisotropy that breaks the point-group symmetry of the Hamiltonian. The functional renormalization group flow of the dimer susceptibility suggests that the QP window splits into two: a region where it grows continuously down to the lowest energy scale to signal valence bond solid (VBS) order, and another region where it reaches a peak at a finite scale and is subsequently suppressed to indicate a QSL.

AI.tldr: 利用改进的赝费米子泛函重整化群(pf-fRG)方法,数值研究方形格子 J1-J2-J3 海森堡模型的零温相图,并将量子顺磁区细分为价键固体(VBS)与量子自旋液体(QSL)两部分。
AI.motivation: 近期张量网络研究报道量子顺磁(QP)区中存在量子自旋液体(QSL),因此需要更精确地刻画 J1-J2-J3 模型的零温相图及 QP 区内部的键序结构。
AI.method: 采用改进频率分辨率和更大格子截断的赝费米子泛函重整化群(pf-fRG);通过施加破坏点群对称性的微小 J1 键各向异性,测量二聚体响应(二聚体磁化率)随 RG 流的变化,并探索远大于以往工作的参数空间。
AI.result: 绘制出扩展 QP 区的相边界,并发现 QP 窗口分裂为两部分:一部分二聚体磁化率持续增长至最低能标,表明存在 VBS 序;另一部分磁化率在有限能标处达峰后受抑,表明为 QSL。
AI.conclusion: 改进的 pf-fRG 能够分辨 QP 区内部的键序细节,支持 J1-J2-J3 方形格子模型中存在 QSL 与 VBS 两个不同区域,为张量网络结果提供数值支持。

title: Motility-Induced Phase Separation of Run-and-Tumble Particles under Local Stochastic Resetting
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, 1 table; v2: typos corrected, citations added, clarifications
summary: We investigate the non-equilibrium stationary states of a one-dimensional active gas composed of run-and-tumble particles (RTPs) undergoing motility-induced phase separation (MIPS) and subjected to local stochastic resetting at the origin. Unlike global resetting, local resetting maintains a mass-injection flux at the origin while preserving large-scale spatial self-organization. We demonstrate that above a critical resetting rate $r_c$, the active system undergoes a transition toward a stationary two-phase state featuring a dense liquid droplet centered at the origin coexisting with a surrounding gas phase. Using kinetic evolution equations, we derive the exact steady-state density profile expressed in terms of the Lambert function. The size of the droplet has a non-monotonic dependence on the resetting rate $r$, and attains its maximum. Furthermore, we analyze the dynamical stability of the supersaturated gas phase and show that a nucleated droplet relaxes exponentially toward its steady-state size with a relaxation timescale of $1/r$. We extend our framework to model a finite resetting velocity, proving that the stationary droplet size is invariant with respect to the resetting velocity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究受原点局域随机重置的run-and-tumble粒子活性气体在MIPS下的非平衡稳态：超过临界重置率后形成以原点为中心的液滴-气体两相共存态，其密度剖面可由Lambert函数精确表达。
AI.motivation: 局域重置与全局重置不同，会持续在原点注入质量却保留大尺度空间自组织，其与 motility-induced phase separation (MIPS) 的耦合机制尚不清楚，临界条件与稳态结构缺乏解析刻画。
AI.method: 基于run-and-tumble粒子的一维动力学演化方程，在原点施加局域随机重置，求精确稳态密度剖面（Lambert函数形式）；分析超饱和气相的动力学稳定性与成核液滴的弛豫过程；并将框架推广至有限重置速度情形。
AI.result: 存在临界重置率 r_c，超过后系统转入致密液滴（位于原点）与周围气相共存的两相稳态；液滴尺寸随 r 非单调变化并存在极大值；成核液滴以 1/r 的弛豫时间指数收敛到稳态尺寸；稳态液滴尺寸与重置速度无关（不变性）。
AI.conclusion: 局域重置可作为调控活性相分离的解析可控工具：给出临界重置率、精确稳态剖面、液滴尺寸极值与 1/r 弛豫时间，并证明尺寸对重置速度的鲁棒性。

title: Nanowire-Assisted Epitaxial Lateral Overgrowth of Planar GaN(0001) on Diamond(100)
summary: GaN-on-diamond heterostructures are promising for high-power and high-frequency electronics, however, direct epi- taxial growth on diamond (100) remains challenging due to severe lattice and thermal mismatches, which induce high threading dislocation densities. To overcome this challenge, we have used Plasma Assisted Molecular Beam Epitaxy (PAMBE) to grow wurtzite GaN layers on diamond(100) substrates using nanowire-assisted epitaxial lateral overgrowth (ELOG). Two nanowire templates (NW100, NW600) were benchmarked against a nanowire-free reference (NW000). High-resolution XRD, φ -scans, (0002) pole figures, and reciprocal space mapping show that NW100 attains the lowest dislocation density (5.51 x 10-4 nm-2) and microstrain (2.736 x 10-3), the narrowest (0002) reflection, and a c-axis lattice parameter (5.1821 Å) within 0.06% of the bulk value; NW000, in contrast, exhibits a contracted c-axis (5.1633 Å) and elevated dislocation density (6.26 x 10-4 nm-2), consistent with residual tensile stress. Cross-sectional TEM con- firms the intended diamond/AlN/nanowire/ELOG/planar-GaN layer sequence and shows threading dislocations bending into near-lateral trajectories, directly evidencing defect filtering by the nanowire template. Together, these results estab- lish nanowire-assisted ELOG as an effective strategy to suppress dislocation propagation and recover near-bulk lattice parameters in GaN-on-diamond heteroepitaxy, providing a structurally well-defined platform for device integration.

AI.tldr: 该文用等离子辅助分子束外延(PAMBE)，以纳米线辅助外延横向过生长(ELOG)在金刚石(100)上生长纤锌矿GaN，系统对比两种纳米线模板(NW100、NW600)与无纳米线参考(NW000)，证明NW100可显著降低位错密度与微应变、获得接近体材的晶格参数。
