AI.motivation: GaN-on-diamond异质结构在高功率、高频电子器件中极具前景，但金刚石(100)上直接外延受严重晶格与热失配制约，产生高位错密度，亟需降低穿透位错的技术路径。
AI.method: 采用PAMBE结合纳米线辅助ELOG在金刚石(100)上生长GaN；制备NW100、NW600两种纳米线模板及无纳米线参考NW000进行对比；通过高分辨XRD、φ扫描、(0002)极图与倒易空间 Mapping表征位错密度、微应变、晶格常数，并用截面TEM观察层序与位错行为。
AI.result: NW100位错密度最低(5.51×10⁻⁴ nm⁻²)、微应变最小(2.736×10⁻³)、(0002)反射最窄，c轴晶格常数5.1821 Å与体材偏差仅0.06%；NW000则c轴收缩(5.1633 Å)、位错密度较高(6.26×10⁻⁴ nm⁻²)，与残余张应力一致。截面TEM证实金刚石/AlN/纳米线/ELOG/平面GaN层序，并观察到穿透位错弯折为近横向轨迹，直接证明纳米线模板的缺陷过滤作用。
AI.conclusion: 纳米线辅助ELOG是抑制位错传播、恢复近体材晶格参数的有效策略，为GaN-on-diamond器件集成提供了结构上定义良好的平台。

title: Bicircular light tunable topological phases and nonlinear Hall responses in odd-parity magnets
summary: Altermagnets are an emerging class of magnetic materials that exhibit characteristic features of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Odd-wave magnets, where the momentum-dependent spin splitting follows an odd-parity form factor, provide a distinct platform for exploring unconventional magnetic and topological phenomena. In this work, we demonstrate light-induced topological phase transitions in odd-parity magnets driven by bicircular light. We show that a cascade of topological phase transitions occur as the relative amplitude ratio of the two beams is varied. These are accompanied by sharp changes of the quantum metric. We demonstrate that bicircular light unlocks nonlinear Hall responses arising from Berry curvature and quantum metric in irradiated odd-wave magnets, and formulate the underlying selection rules. Our results show that both the topology and the nonlinear responses in odd-parity magnets can be directly controlled by a bicircular drive.

AI.tldr: 双圆偏振光驱动奇波磁体可实现级联拓扑相变，并解锁由贝里曲率与量子度规产生的非线性霍尔响应，且可通过选择定则加以调控。
AI.motivation: 奇波磁体（odd-wave magnets）兼具铁磁与反铁磁特征，其动量依赖的自旋劈裂呈奇宇称形式，为非常规磁性与拓扑现象提供了独特平台。作者希望找到一种能直接、可控地调节这类材料拓扑与响应性质的外场手段。
AI.method: 采用双圆偏振光（bicircular light）驱动奇宇称磁体，系统改变两束光的相对振幅比，研究由此诱导的拓扑相变；同时计算量子度规的变化，并推导贝里曲率与量子度规贡献的非线性霍尔响应的选择定则。
AI.result: 随两束光相对振幅比变化，体系出现一系列级联拓扑相变，并伴随量子度规的剧烈变化；辐照后的奇波磁体中可产生非线性霍尔响应，并可依据选择定则区分贝里曲率与量子度规的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 双圆偏振光可同时对奇宇称磁体的拓扑相与非线性响应实现直接控制，为光调控磁性拓扑材料提供了一种新途径。

title: Time-Reversal Symmetry Breaking in the Centrosymmetric Nonsymmorphic Superconductor RuB2
summary: Centrosymmetric nonsymmorphic AB2 (A = Ru, Os) borides exhibit anomalous superconducting properties, but the microscopic nature of their superconducting ground state remains unresolved. Here, we investigate RuB2 using zero- and transverse-field muon spin relaxation (muSR), first-principles electronic-structure calculations, and Ginzburg-Landau symmetry analysis. Zero-field muSR reveals spontaneous internal magnetic fields below Tc = 1.6 K, providing direct evidence for time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB). Transverse-field measurements establish a fully gapped superconducting state, with a gap magnitude close to the BCS weak-coupling limit. Density-functional calculations show that RuB2 is a multiband Z2 topological metal with appreciable spin-orbit coupling. Guided by the experimental observations and the symmetry of the orthorhombic crystal structure, our Ginzburg-Landau analysis suggests that an internally antisymmetric, nonunitary spin-triplet state is a promising candidate for the superconducting order parameter. This candidate is consistent with both the observed TRSB and the fully gapped superconducting state. These results establish RuB2 as a promising platform for investigating unconventional superconductivity arising from the interplay of crystal symmetry, multiband electronic structure, and spin-orbit coupling, and motivate further studies of related nonsymmorphic borides. The two muSR measurements provide complementary constraints: zero-field data probe spontaneous magnetism associated with TRSB, while transverse-field data characterize superconducting field distribution and support a full gap. The topological electronic structure and spin-orbit coupling provide context for unconventional pairing. Although these results do not uniquely determine the order parameter, they narrow candidates and highlight that nonsymmorphic symmetry may shape superconductivity in RuB2.

AI.tldr: 用muSR、第一性原理和Ginzburg-Landau分析研究RuB2，发现Tc=1.6 K以下自发内磁场（时间反演对称破缺）与完全能隙超导态，并推测内部反对称非单一自旋三重态为候选序参量。
AI.motivation: 中心对称非简单空间群AB2（A=Ru, Os）硼化物表现出反常超导性，但其超导基态的微观本质尚未解决，需要直接实验证据来确定配对对称性。
AI.method: 零场与横场μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）测量；第一性原理电子结构计算（DFT）；Ginzburg-Landau对称性分析。
AI.result: 零场μSR在Tc=1.6 K以下观测到自发内磁场，直接证据表明时间反演对称破缺；横场测量表明为完全能隙超导态，能隙大小接近BCS弱耦合极限；计算显示RuB2是多带Z2拓扑金属且具有显著自旋轨道耦合；GL分析表明内部反对称的非单一自旋三重态是候选序参量，与TRSB和全能隙均一致。
AI.conclusion: RuB2是研究晶体对称性、多带电子结构与自旋轨道耦合相互作用所导致非常规超导的有前景平台；结果虽不能唯一确定序参量，但缩小了候选范围，并提示非简单空间群对称性可能塑造其超导性，值得进一步研究相关硼化物。

title: Hidden piezo-Hall effect
summary: Extensive studies of hidden spin polarization have established a broad class of hidden phenomena in quantum materials. Here, we introduce the hidden piezo-Hall effect, in which strain induces finite anomalous Hall conductivities (AHCs) in individual sectors while the global AHC remains zero. At zero strain, neither the full system nor its sectors exhibit an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Under uniaxial strain, however, opposite sector AHCs emerge while their sum remains canceled. We establish this effect for a $d$-wave hidden altermagnet using a tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for the experimentally synthesized material $\mathrm{RbV_2Te_2O}$. Rotating the strain direction from the $x$ to the $y$ axis reverses the signs of the sector AHCs without generating a net Hall response. The same symmetry mechanism may also give rise to hidden piezomagneto-optical, piezo-thermal Hall, piezo-Nernst, and piezo-Ettingshausen effects. Our work extends hidden physics to strain-controlled transport and identifies $\mathrm{RbV_2Te_2O}$ as a promising candidate for experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 提出"隐藏压霍尔效应"：应变在保持全局零霍尔响应的前提下，使各扇区产生相反的异常霍尔电导，并在RbV2Te2O中实现。
AI.motivation: 隐藏自旋极化等"隐藏现象"已成体系，但此前主要局限于自旋与能带层面，尚缺乏将隐藏物理推广到应变调控输运性质的机制。
AI.method: 基于紧束缚模型与第一性原理计算，研究d波隐藏交替磁体（隐藏altermagnet）材料RbV2Te2O。
AI.result: 零应变时体系与各扇区均无AHE；单轴应变下两扇区出现大小相等、符号相反的AHC且相互抵消；将应变从x轴转到y轴可使扇区AHC变号而净霍尔响应仍为零。
AI.conclusion: 该效应将隐藏物理拓展到应变调控的输运领域，同一对称机制还可推广到隐藏压磁光、压热霍尔、压能斯特及压埃廷斯豪森效应，RbV2Te2O是有前景的实验候选材料。

title: Machine Learning-Assisted Discovery of Carbon-Related Defect Formation Mechanisms in Diamond
summary: Diamond is an important host material for functional defects such as solid-state spin qubits. During the defect creation by irradiation and subsequent thermal annealing, carbon-related defects, including vacancies and interstitials, are generated and can migrate to form new defect complexes. To investigate this kinetically driven process and reveal the formation mechanisms of the di-interstitials and di-vacancies in the neutral charge state, we fine-tuned a universal machine learning interatomic potential using a small dataset generated from density functional theory calculations. We obtained a barrier of 1.84 eV for mono-interstitial migration and found that two initially separated mono-interstitials only need to overcome a lower barrier to form di-interstitial configurations. Beyond the training data, the MLIP also identified the formation pathway for an additional di-interstitial configuration and a stepwise divacancy dissociation mechanism. These results reveal migration-assisted defect complex formation mechanisms and demonstrate how targeted MLIP training can identify reaction pathways.

AI.tldr: 通过小规模DFT数据微调通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP），研究金刚石中中性双间隙与双空位的形成与解离机制，得到单间隙迁移势垒1.84 eV，并发现双间隙形成需跨越更低势垒。
AI.motivation: 金刚石是固态自旋量子比特等功能缺陷的重要宿主材料；辐照加退火过程中产生的碳相关缺陷（空位、间隙）会迁移并形成新缺陷复合体，需要揭示其动力学驱动的形成机制。
AI.method: 用密度泛函理论计算生成的少量数据集，精细微调一个通用机器学习原子间势（MLIP），并用其搜索中性双间隙与双空位的形成/解离路径。
AI.result: 得到单间隙迁移势垒为1.84 eV；两个初始分离的单间隙仅需跨越更低势垒即可形成双间隙构型；此外MLIP还识别出另一种双间隙构型的形成路径以及分步式的双空位解离机制。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了迁移辅助的缺陷复合体形成机制，并表明有针对性的MLIP训练能够有效识别反应路径。

title: La14.33(CN3)8N, a Nitridocarbonate based on the (CN3)5- Ion
summary: Metal nitridocarbonates containing the (NCN)2- ion are established for a multitude of metal atoms throughout the periodic table. The preparation of nitridocarbonate compounds containing a (CN3)5-, (C2N4)6-, or (C3N6)6- ion remains challenging, although corresponding species have been established. The new compound La14.33(CN3)8N was synthesized in a conventional solid-state metathesis reaction from a mixture of LaF3, Na2(CN2) and Li3N in an open system at 550 °C. The reaction conditions, including the formation and de-composition of La14.33(CN3)8N are analyzed on basis of thermoanalytic studies. The crystal structure of La14.33(CN3)8N was refined by single-crystal X-ray diffraction, and the mid-IR frequencies resulting from two crystallographically distinct (CN3)5- ions in the structure are reported. 23Na, 7Li and 13C NMR studies provide additional support for the identity of the compound. The crystal structure of La14.33(CN3)8N is isotypic to that of Ce15(BN3)8N.

AI.tldr: 首次在常规固态复分解反应中合成含(CN3)5-离子（而非熟悉的(NCN)2-）的新化合物La14.33(CN3)8N，并完成结构、热行为与谱学表征。
AI.motivation: (NCN)2-基金属氮碳化物已广泛建立，但含(CN3)5-、(C2N4)6-、(C3N6)6-等更高聚合氮碳阴离子的化合物合成仍十分困难，相关物种鲜有报道，亟需拓展此类材料的可控制备与结构认识。
AI.method: 以LaF3、Na2(CN2)与Li3N混合物为原料，在开放体系550 °C下进行常规固态复分解反应合成La14.33(CN3)8N；结合热分析研究反应条件及该化合物的生成与分解行为；用单晶X射线衍射精修晶体结构；测量中红外光谱（两种晶体学独立的(CN3)5-离子）；并辅以23Na、7Li、13C固体NMR验证。
AI.result: 成功获得La14.33(CN3)8N单晶并解析其结构，结构中存在两种晶体学独立的(CN3)5-离子，中红外振动频率被指认；23Na、7Li与13C NMR结果支持该化合物组成；其晶体结构与Ce15(BN3)8N同型（isotypic）。
AI.conclusion: 证明含(CN3)5-离子的稀土氮碳化物可通过简单固态复分解路线制得，为拓展非(NCN)2-型氮碳（氮碳硼）化合物的合成与结构化学提供了新实例与表征范式。

title: Poisson-shot-noise induced escape dynamics of a passive particle and a dimer
comment: 38 pages, 13 figures, Accepted in Physica A (2026)
summary: Mean First Passage Time (MFPT) is a crucial quantity that characterizes stochastic processes in various stochastic dynamical systems across different disciplines. The inverse of the MFPT, known as the escape rate, is helpful in the context of Brownian motion and chemical processes. The MFPT dynamics of a passive particle in the presence of active noises presents a fascinating avenue. In this work, we study the dynamics of two different systems: first, a single Brownian particle and second, a dimer (two Brownian particles connected by a spring). In both cases, the systems are kept in contact with a thermal bath and an active bath, and are trapped in a bistable potential. The active bath produces kicks that follow the Poisson distribution. The MFPT of the particle and the dimer is investigated in various scenarios. Analytical results are presented for the small kick variance approximation only. In this approximation, we formulate the MFPT in two scaling regimes: a weak-noise regime characterized by classical Arrhenius scaling for escape rate and a strong-noise regime in which the MFPT scales as a power law in the effective noise strength. For the general case, the problem is solved numerically. Next, under the same approximation, the MFPT of a dimer in the small-bond-strength regime is studied using a sequential-hopping mechanism, and in the large-bond-strength regime, the MFPT is formulated using the adiabatic elimination approach. Motivated by recent studies on speeding up the escape mechanism, the MFPT of the particle and the dimer in the presence of an intermediate barrier is also examined. We deduced from the numerical results that the MFPT can be enhanced and further optimized by selecting a suitable intermediate potential profile.

AI.tldr: 研究被动粒子与双聚体在热浴和泊松活性噪声浴中、处于双稳势阱内的平均首次通过时间(MFPT)，用解析与数值方法分析其在不同标度区及中间势垒调控下的行为。
AI.motivation: MFPT及逃逸率是刻画随机动力系统的关键量，而活性噪声（泊松分布踢动）对被动粒子及耦合二聚体MFPT的影响尚待系统研究，且受近期关于加速逃逸机制的研究启发。
AI.method: 考察单布朗粒子与由弹簧连接的二聚体两类系统，均接触热浴与活性浴并置于双稳势阱。在活性踢动方差较小的近似下，推导弱噪声(Arrhenius标度)与强噪声(幂律标度)两个标度区的MFPT解析表达式；一般情形用数值求解。对二聚体进一步在弱键强度下用顺序跳跃机制、强键强度下用绝热消去法处理，并考察含中间势垒时的MFPT。
AI.result: 给出小踢动方差近似下两标度区的MFPT解析式，一般情形获数值解；二聚体在弱/强键极限分别由顺序跳跃与绝热消去描述；数值结果表明适当选取中间势垒轮廓可增强并进一步优化MFPT。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择合适的中间势垒轮廓，可增强并优化粒子与二聚体的MFPT，为调控活性浴中逃逸过程提供途径。

title: High-order resonances and emergent coherent dynamics in interacting Stark chains
summary: A linear potential gradient can strongly suppress quantum dynamics, while interactions can activate resonant many-body processes whose higher-order structure remains largely unexplored. Here we uncover a systematic hierarchy of high-order interaction--tilt resonances in an interacting Stark chain, where the resonance order counts the minimal number of elementary exchange steps involved. These resonances manifest as long-lived coherent oscillations with order-dependent timescales. By isolating individual resonant channels and developing a microscopic effective description, we connect these dynamical timescales to the underlying many-body exchange processes and reveal a pronounced dependence on the initial-state structure. Our results provide crucial insights into high-order many-body resonances and show how commensurate interaction-to-tilt ratios generate a hierarchy of parametrically slow coherent many-body dynamics.

AI.tldr: 在相互作用Stark链中，作者揭示了由相互作用与倾斜势之比决定的高阶共振层级，表现为寿命很长、时间尺度依赖共振阶数的相干振荡，并给出微观有效理论。
AI.motivation: 线性势梯度能强烈抑制量子动力学，而相互作用可激活共振多体过程；但这些高阶共振结构基本未被探索，本文欲系统刻画其层级。
AI.method: 在相互作用Stark链中识别高阶相互作用—倾斜共振，定义共振阶数为最小基本交换步数；通过隔离单个共振通道并构建微观有效描述，将动力学时间尺度与多体交换过程联系。
AI.result: 发现系统的共振层级，表现为长寿命相干振荡，其时间尺度依赖共振阶数；这些时间尺度与底层多体交换过程对应，并明显依赖初始态结构。
AI.conclusion: 共约的相互作用—倾斜比可产生参数性慢的相干多体动力学层级，为理解高阶多体共振提供关键认识。

title: Investigating relative population partitioning in the presence of B$^-_\text{C}$ defects in diamond
summary: Leveraging our earlier formalism for charge-state decay [see R. Kuate Defo et al., 108 235208 (2023)], we investigate relative population partitioning in the presence of singly negatively charged substitutional boron impurities (B$^-_{\rm C}$) in diamond samples, where these diamond samples also contain substitutional nitrogen (N$_{\rm C }$) impurities and have ether-terminated surfaces. Effectively, given any two defects, one donor and one acceptor, such that their charge-transition levels, their relative populations, and the temperature are known, the timescale for charge transfer between the two defects is completely determined. We use this insight and experimental measurements for the timescale for charge transfer between NV$^-$ centers and N$_{\rm C}$ hybridized with the ether-terminated surface of diamond, as well as the temperature and the relative populations for the NV$^-$ centers, [see Z. Yuan et al., Phys. Rev. Res. 2, 033263 (2020)] to argue that an additional defect must be modulating the relative populations of N$_{\rm C}$ hybridized with the ether-terminated surface of diamond. The shifts in the local Fermi level for N$_{\rm C}$ hybridized with the ether-terminated surface of diamond are consistent with the additional defect being a substitutional boron impurity (B$_{\rm C}$). Ultimately, our results allow for the determination of local relative concentrations of ionized defects.

AI.tldr: 基于此前的电荷态衰减形式理论，作者研究含B⁻_C与N_C缺陷、醚终止表面的金刚石中的相对布居分配，并论证除NV⁻与N_C外还须存在额外缺陷（即B_C）调制布居。
AI.motivation: 理解金刚石中供体-受主缺陷间电荷转移与电荷态布居，需明确在已知电荷跃迁能级、相对布居和温度时如何确定电荷转移时标，并解释实验中NV⁻与N_C体系布居无法由已知缺陷单独解释的现象。
AI.method: 沿用前期电荷态衰减形式理论：给定两个缺陷（一供体一受主）的电荷跃迁能级、相对布居与温度，即可完全确定电荷转移时标；结合NV⁻与N_C（杂化于醚终止表面）之间电荷转移时标的实验测量，以及温度与NV⁻相对布居数据，反推是否存在额外缺陷并分析局部费米能级移动。
AI.result: 实验时标与布居数据表明，必须由额外缺陷调制N_C（醚终止表面杂化）的相对布居；其局部费米能级移动与替代式硼杂质B_C一致。
AI.conclusion: 该形式框架可借电荷转移时标与布居数据识别隐藏缺陷，并最终实现金刚石中电离缺陷局部相对浓度的确定。

title: Origins of Faceted Anomalous Scaling
summary: Fluctuating interfaces are typically characterized by their global, spectral, and local roughness exponents. Faceted anomalous scaling, characterized by $α_s>1$, $α_s\neqα$, and $α_{\mathrm{loc}}=1$, owes its name to the tendency of such interfaces to develop long, nearly linear segments called facets. Its statistical origin, and whether facets are required, have remained unclear. We show that this exponent structure is determined by the spatial statistics of the slope field. Slope increments split into typical fluctuations and rare, larger jumps. This anomalous scaling arises either when the typical slope increment displays genuine system-size-dependent anomalous scaling or when the rare jumps dominate the second moment. The two contributions can coexist, and their competition leads to bifractal scaling of the slopes. We establish this framework analytically in the generalized anharmonic Larkin model and the columnar Kardar--Parisi--Zhang equation, and we derive exactly the global, spectral, and local roughness exponents in both cases. The Larkin model realizes both mechanisms and produces anomalous interfaces with or without facets, whereas columnar KPZ belongs to the jump-dominated case and yields $α_s=3/2$.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示"faceted anomalous scaling"（α_s>1、α_s≠α、α_loc=1）的统计起源，指出其由斜率场的空间统计决定：斜率增量分为典型涨落与稀有跃迁，二者竞争决定反常标度并导致斜率双分形。
AI.motivation: 该类界面反常标度（faceted anomalous scaling）的统计起源不明，且"是否必须有facets（长近线性段）"这一问题长期未解。
AI.method: 将斜率增量分解为典型涨落与稀有大幅跃迁两类贡献，建立分析框架；在广义非谐Larkin模型与柱状KPZ方程中解析推导全局、谱、局域粗糙度指数。
AI.result: 反常标度有两种机制：一是典型斜率增量存在真正的尺寸依赖反常标度；二是稀有跃迁主导二阶矩。二者可共存，竞争导致斜率双分形。Larkin模型同时实现两种机制，产生有或无facets的反常界面；柱状KPZ属跃迁主导情形，给出α_s=3/2。
AI.conclusion: faceted anomalous scaling源于斜率场统计而非必然需要facets；该框架统一解释了两种机制及其共存。

title: Spatiotemporal Imaging of Thermally Driven Metal-Insulator Phase Domain Propagation in VO2
summary: Achieving a detailed picture of the nature and dynamics of phase boundaries remains a major challenge, particularly solid-solid transitions central to phase-change materials. Here, we use stroboscopic optical scattering microscopy and finite-element simulations to study the nonlinear thermally driven motion of the mesoscale insulator-metal phase boundary in VO2 thin films. We visualize the lateral spatiotemporal evolution of a diffraction-limited photoinduced metallic phase domain, resolving its outward propagation, contraction, and ultimate disappearance. The phase boundary dynamics are governed by heat flow, which can be controlled by excitation fluence, film thickness, and substrate thermal conductivity. Parameter-free agreement between the data and nonlinear thermal transport simulations identify the phase boundary transport as locally diffusive under this regime. We quantify how the latent heat acts as a thermal inertia, suppressing transport and prolonging the phase coexistence. Paradoxically, despite being driven by the underlying thermal gradient locally described by Fourier's law, the mesoscale phase front propagates faster than expected from thermal diffusion. This phenomenon arises from the distinction between temperature-field evolution and phase-boundary isotherm motion. These results establish a link between heat dissipation and mesoscale phase-front motion, providing a framework for controlling phase-transition kinetics relevant to photonics applications of VO2. We anticipate that this approach generalizes to a broad class of first- and second-order transitions.

AI.tldr: 该工作用频闪光学散射显微镜与有限元模拟，研究VO2薄膜中绝缘体-金属相界的非线性热驱动运动，揭示了相界输运在局域为扩散型但介观相前传播快于热扩散的反常现象。
AI.motivation: 固-固相变的相界性质与动力学（尤其相变材料中）难以精细刻画，缺乏对介观相界时空演化的直接观测与定量理解。
AI.method: 采用频闪（stroboscopic）光学散射显微镜，对VO2薄膜中光致金属相畴的横向时空演化进行成像，追踪其向外扩展、收缩与消失；结合有限元非线性热输运模拟，并通过激发通量、膜厚、衬底热导率调控热流。
AI.result: 数据与无参数非线性热输运模拟定量吻合，表明相界输运在该区间为局域扩散；潜热表现为"热惯性"，抑制输运并延长相共存时间；尽管由傅里叶定律描述的局域热梯度驱动，介观相前传播速度却快于热扩散预期。
AI.conclusion: 该速度反常源于温度场演化与相界等温线运动之间的区别；研究建立了热耗散与介观相前运动的联系，为VO2光子学应用中相变动力学的调控提供框架，并预期可推广到一大类一阶与二阶相变。

title: An infinite sequence of higher order Ehrenfest transitions in a one-dimensional crystal
summary: Higher-order Ehrenfest phase transitions are exceptionally rare and poorly understood. We present an exactly solvable one-dimensional model exhibiting a sequence of Ehrenfest transitions of arbitrary $n\geq2$ order. These transitions occur without symmetry breaking and even the second-order transition lacks conventional critical behavior, although the density derivative of the correlation length diverges. Our results reveal a distinct class of noncritical phase transitions and help clarify the scope of the Ehrenfest classification.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个一维严格可解模型，展示任意 n≥2 阶的 Ehrenfest 相变序列，这些相变无对称破缺，揭示了一类"非临界"相变。
AI.motivation: 高阶 Ehrenfest 相变极为罕见且理解不足，其分类框架的适用范围也不清晰，需要可严格求解的范例来厘清。
AI.method: 提出一个一维精确可解模型，其中相变按 Ehrenfest 分类呈现任意高阶（n≥2）的序列；并分析序参量、对称性与关联长度行为。
AI.result: 相变序列中无对称破缺；连二阶相变也缺乏常规临界行为，但关联长度对密度的导数发散。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了一类独特的非临界相变，有助于阐明 Ehrenfest 分类的适用范围。

title: Atomic-level study of dose-dependent lattice thermal conductivity degradation in irradiated tungsten
summary: Plasma-facing components (PFCs) in future fusion reactors must withstand extreme environments, making tungsten (W) a prime candidate material due to its high thermal conductivity, high melting temperature, low sputtering yield, low tritium absorption. However, neutron irradiation introduces complex nanostructural defects that severely degrade these critical properties. In this work, we use Non-Equilibrium Molecular Dynamics (NEMD) simulations coupled with the Creation Relaxation Algorithm (CRA) to investigate the lattice thermal conductivity (kappa) of W across a wide range of irradiation doses. Systems treated with different doses up to 1.8 canonical displacements per atom (cdpa) were simulated to generate and study diverse defect structures, including vacancies and self-interstitial atom (SIA) clusters. By correlating spatially-resolved temperature gradients with local defect concentrations, we show that even small changes in defect type and distribution significantly affect thermal transport. We employ Machine Learning (ML) models to develop a quantitative relationship between the defect features and the resulting thermal conductivity degradation. The ML analysis identifies vacancy density as the dominant structural factor controlling thermal transport. We found a significant, nonlinear suppression of kappa with increasing defect density. Predictive multi-defect mapping built upon our ML model resolved a step-like degradation transition at a critical vacancy threshold of 0.05 at.%, beyond which phonon scattering completely saturated and capped the maximum relative lattice thermal conductivity degradation at approximately 30 at.%. This integrated simulation and ML approach provides a powerful, predictive framework for quantifying the complex relationship between structure and thermal conductivity in irradiated fusion materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合非平衡分子动力学(NEMD)与Creation Relaxation Algorithm(CRA)模拟中子辐照钨的晶格热导率(κ)，并用机器学习建立缺陷特征与热导率退化的定量关系，发现空位密度是主导因素，且在0.05 at.%空位阈值处出现阶跃式退化转变。
AI.motivation: 未来聚变堆的面向等离子体部件必须承受极端环境，钨(W)因高热导率、高熔点、低溅射产额、低氚吸附成为首选材料。但中子辐照引入的复杂纳米尺度缺陷会严重恶化这些关键性能，因此需要定量理解辐照缺陷结构与热导率退化之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用NEMD模拟并耦合CRA算法，生成辐照剂量高达1.8 cdpa的钨系统，涵盖空位与自间隙原子(SIA)团簇等多样缺陷结构；将空间分辨的温度梯度与局域缺陷浓度相关联，分析缺陷类型与分布对热输运的影响；再引入机器学习模型，构建缺陷特征与热导率退化之间的定量映射。
AI.result: 即使缺陷类型和分布发生微小变化，也会显著影响热输运；ML分析表明空位密度是控制热输运的主导结构因素；κ随缺陷密度增加呈显著非线性抑制。基于ML模型的多缺陷预测映射揭示出在0.05 at.%临界空位阈值处存在阶跃式退化转变，超过该阈值后声子散射完全饱和，最大相对晶格热导率退化被限制在约30 at.%。
AI.conclusion: 该集成模拟与机器学习的方法为量化辐照聚变材料中结构与热导率之间的复杂关系提供了有力的预测性框架。

title: Coexistence phase of the two-dimensional Vicsek model
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Companion paper to "Phase Diagram of the Two-Dimensional Vicsek Model"
summary: The Vicsek model continues to be central in statistical physics studies of active matter, with major recent surprises such as the partial metastability of the famous Toner-Tu flocking phase. Here we report on the diversity of band patterns observed in its coexistence phase --some of them never observed before--, but we also argue that most disappear in the infinite-size limit, leaving nevertheless a different picture than anticipated previously. We finally show that these rather regular, globally ordered band configurations can be destroyed by a localized perturbation: the coexistence phase is also at least partially metastable, and thus must be, asymptotically, a disordered phase made of a variety of chaotically interacting traveling bands.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Vicsek模型共存相中的带状图案多样性，提出多数带状图案在无穷大尺寸极限下消失，并证明共存相至少部分亚稳，可被局域扰动破坏，渐近上应是无序的混沌相互作用行波带相。
AI.motivation: Vicsek模型是活性物质统计物理的核心模型，近期发现Toner-Tu群集相存在部分亚稳性等意外现象。作者希望厘清共存相中带状图案的真实命运，检验此前对共存相的图像是否准确。
AI.method: 基于Vicsek模型的数值模拟，考察共存相中带状图案的多样形态（含此前未见的图案），并分析其随系统尺寸的有限尺寸标度行为；同时引入局域扰动测试带状构型的稳定性。
AI.result: 观察到多种带状图案，部分为首次发现；但多数图案在无穷大尺寸极限下消失，最终图像与既有预期不同。规则且全局有序的带状构型可被局域扰动破坏，表明共存相至少部分亚稳。
AI.conclusion: 共存相渐近上并非稳定有序带相，而是由混沌相互作用的多条行波带组成的无序相；此前对Vicsek共存相的稳定有序图像需修正。

title: Phase Diagram of the Two-Dimensional Vicsek Model
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Companion paper to "Coexistence phase of the two-dimensional Vicsek model"
summary: Motivated by gaps in our current knowledge of the Vicsek model, we present a major update of its phase diagram in two space dimensions, summarizing comprehensive numerical simulations at length- and timescales never explored before. Our main conclusions are that multiple phase separation scenarios are at play, not just the simple microphase separation put forward in [Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 068101 (2015)], and that the coexistence phase is subdivided in two. We also map out the region of metastability of the homogeneous Toner-Tu liquid phase.

AI.tldr: 对二维Vicsek模型相图进行大规模数值模拟更新，发现存在多种相分离情形，共存相分为两部分，并给出均匀Toner-Tu液相亚稳区域。
AI.motivation: 现有对Vicsek模型的认知存在空白，此前仅提出简单的微相分离图像，缺乏在超长时空尺度上的系统检验。
AI.method: 在二维空间中进行全面的数值模拟，时间与空间尺度均超过以往研究。
AI.result: 发现存在多种相分离情形（不止此前PRL 114, 068101提出的微相分离）；共存相被细分为两个；绘制出均匀Toner-Tu液相的亚稳区域。
AI.conclusion: Vicsek模型二维相图需大幅修订，相分离图像更复杂，共存相具有内部结构，且均匀有序相存在亚稳区。

title: Avalanches and Aging Driven by Parametric Amplification in Kerr Oscillator Networks
comment: 24 pages, 10 figures. Revised and shortened presentation
summary: Gain, loss, and nonlinearity shape the phase-space landscape of driven-dissipative systems, such as Kerr parametric oscillator (KPO) networks realized in superconducting, nanomechanical, and photonic arrays. Networks of KPOs exploit the stationary states of this landscape for Ising machines, bosonic error-correcting codes, and sensing. Yet how transients reach these states from a given initial condition remains largely unexplored. Here we show that KPO networks with nonlinear couplings can develop avalanches in their deterministic transient dynamics: rapid cascades of amplification between modes reminiscent of the relaxation avalanches of glassy systems. The mechanism is that parametric gain first activates the modes whose detuning it can overcome, and their nonlinear frequency shifts then pull dormant modes into the gain window one at a time. Dormant modes keep decaying while they wait for their turn, so every activation starts from a smaller seed and the intervals between activations grow geometrically. The network thus ages: the longer it has evolved, the slower it changes, and activations accumulate only logarithmically in time. In a 20-mode network, each dwell lasts about twice as long as the previous one.

AI.tldr: KPO网络在非线性耦合下的确定性瞬态动力学中会出现"雪崩"式放大级联，且激活间隔几何增长，导致网络"老化"、激活数随时间仅对数累积。
AI.motivation: KPO网络（用于Ising机、玻色纠错码、传感）主要研究稳态相空间景观，而系统如何从给定初态通过瞬态到达这些稳态仍鲜有研究，本文旨在揭示这一瞬态动力学。
AI.method: 分析含非线性耦合的KPO网络的确定性瞬态动力学，追踪模间放大级联过程；机制为参量增益先激活失谐可克服的模，其非线性频移再把休眠模逐一拉入增益窗口。
AI.result: 发现类玻璃体系的弛豫雪崩现象。休眠模等待期间持续衰减，使每次激活的种子更小，激活间隔几何增长；20模网络中每次驻留时间约为上一次的两倍，激活仅随时间对数累积。
AI.conclusion: KPO网络的瞬态具有"老化"特征——演化越久变化越慢，这为理解驱动耗散网络如何抵达稳态提供了新视角，并可能影响相关计算与传感应用的设计。

title: Probing the physical origins of 1/f noise by nonlinear transport
summary: We report measurements of low frequency noise in the nonlinear electron transport of tunnel junctions that are dc or ac biased. We show that not only the resistance but also the nonlinear coefficients exhibit $1/f$-like noise, and that correlations among them exist. Using the common theoretical model for electron transport in tunnel junctions, we relate our measurements to fluctuations of barrier heights. We show in particular that the barrier heights on either side of the junction have strong fluctuations that are almost perfectly anti-correlated.

AI.tldr: 隧道结在直流或交流偏置下的非线性电子输运低频噪声测量表明，不仅电阻、非线性系数也呈现1/f型噪声且相互关联，可归因于势垒高度涨落，且结两侧势垒高度涨落几近完全反相关。
AI.motivation: 以往低频噪声研究多关注线性区电阻的1/f噪声，而对非线性输运区（非线性系数）是否同样存在噪声、以及不同输运系数之间是否存在关联缺乏实验检验。
AI.method: 对直流/交流偏置的隧道结测量非线性输运中的低频噪声，同时提取电阻与各阶非线性系数的噪声，并分析它们之间的相关性；再用隧道结电子输运的常用理论模型将测量结果映射为势垒高度的涨落。
AI.result: 电阻与非线性系数均表现出类1/f噪声，且各系数之间存在相关性；这些噪声可解释为势垒高度涨落所致，其中结两侧的势垒高度涨落很强且几乎完全反相关。
AI.conclusion: 低频噪声是探测隧道结非线性输运与势垒涨落的有效手段；两侧势垒高度的反相关涨落提示存在共同的电荷或界面涨落机制，需在噪声模型中同时计入多参数关联。

title: From particles to continuum theories in effective models of self-propelled rods
summary: Models of colliding self-propelled rods are abstractions of many real systems such as gliding bacteria and biofilaments displaced by molecular motors. They have been studied mostly in two space dimensions and shown to display a wealth of different collective regimes with many parameters involved in the ensuing phase diagrams. Continuum-level theories faithful to this phenomenology are largely lacking since coarse-graining models of explicit rods is notoriously difficult. Here we study collections of particles in which the rods geometry is taken into account effectively, by implementing the nematic alignment of their velocities and two types of repulsion. These Vicsek-style models are simple enough to be starting points for systematic coarse-graining. We thus derive hydrodynamic equations that we show to have solutions qualitatively faithful to their particle-level origin.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一类简化版Vicsek式自驱动棒模型（速度向列对齐+两种排斥），并推导出能定性复现粒子级行为的流体力学方程。
AI.motivation: 碰撞自驱动棒模型（如滑行细菌、被分子马达推动的生物丝）多局限于二维、参数繁多，且对显式棒模型做粗粒化极为困难，缺乏忠实的连续介质理论。
AI.method: 用"有效"方式考虑棒几何：对粒子速度施加向列对齐，并引入两类排斥作用，构建足够简单、可作为系统粗粒化起点的Vicsek式模型，再推导其流体力学方程。
AI.result: 推导出的流体力学方程的解与粒子级模型在定性上保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 该简化模型为自驱动棒系统的系统化粗粒化提供了可行起点，并得到与微观模型定性吻合的宏观理论。

title: Strain-induced disorder from Schottky gates on high mobility 2DEGs
summary: Electrostatic gates on two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) in GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructures are essential for numerous studies of correlation driven phenomena, many performed within the fractional quantum Hall effect. However, the most commonly used type of gates, the metallic Schottky gate, has the propensity to adversely impact the electron mobility and suppress the fractional quantum Hall states. Here we demonstrate through commensurability oscillations under specially designed nanostructured superlattice gates, that strain effects are responsible for the mobility reduction. The experimental results agree well with COMSOL Multiphysics simulations. In a regular, unpatterned gate the disordered, granular nature of the metal film fills the same role as the superlattice in creating a strain field penetrating down to the 2DEG, as we show with a simplified model. These results will help in understanding, improving and finding novel methods to reduce strain-induced disorder in gated high-mobility 2DEGs.

AI.tldr: 该文通过超晶格栅极下的可通约振荡实验证明，金属栅极引起的应变效应是导致GaAs/AlGaAs二维电子气迁移率下降的原因，并与COMSOL仿真吻合；无图案颗粒状金属膜也通过应变场影响2DEG。
AI.motivation: 金属肖特基栅极常用于调控GaAs/AlGaAs 2DEG以研究分数量子霍尔等关联现象，但会降低迁移率并抑制分数量子霍尔态，其机制（应变vs静电）此前并不清楚。
AI.method: 在特别设计的纳米结构超晶格栅极下测量可通约振荡，以分离应变效应；用COMSOL Multiphysics进行有限元仿真对照，并对无图案颗粒金属栅建立简化模型分析其应变场。
AI.result: 可通约振荡表明迁移率下降源于应变效应而非纯静电效应，实验与COMSOL仿真吻合良好；简化模型显示普通无图案栅极中金属膜的颗粒无序性可产生穿透至2DEG的应变场，作用类似超晶格。
AI.conclusion: 应变诱导无序是金属栅极降低高迁移率2DEG质量的关键因素，该认识有助于理解、改进并探索减少栅控2DEG中应变诱导无序的新方法。

title: Stabilization of Ferroelectric Domains via Interfacial Strain in HoFeO3- BaTiO3 Nanofiber Heterostructures for Enhanced Hybrid Energy Harvesting
summary: Piezoelectric nanogenerators (PENGs) are an attractive platform for self-powered mechanical-energy harvesting, but their output is often limited by depolarization fields, charge leakage, and inefficient stress transfer to the active dipoles, particularly in polymer-dominated composites. Here we report HoFeO3-BaTiO3 (HFO-BTO) nanofiber heterostructures prepared by alternating sol-gel electrospinning, in which orthorhombic HoFeO3 (Pbnm) and tetragonal BaTiO3 (P4mm) coexist in intimate contact. Rietveld-refined X-ray diffraction, high-resolution transmission electron microscopy, and Raman spectroscopy indicate interfacial lattice distortion. Polarization-electric field loops show that the heterostructure retains a polarization comparable to that of BaTiO3 (16.39 vs 15.80 microcoulombs per square centimeter at zero field) while its switching-current maximum moves to a higher field (about 7 vs about 3.5 kilovolts per centimeter), consistent with strain-stabilized ferroelectric domains. When the nanofibers are encapsulated in polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and excited under cyclic impact, the device produces a hybrid output: the piezoelectric response of the strained BaTiO3 is supplemented by a triboelectric contribution from contact electrification. The HFO-BTO device delivers open-circuit voltage peaks of about +6 volts and -8 volts and a power density of 24.31 microwatts per cubic centimeter at a 4.7 megaohm load. This is 2.4 times the value for an identically fabricated BaTiO3 device (10.00 microwatts per cubic centimeter) and 8.7 times that of the HoFeO3 device (2.78 microwatts per cubic centimeter). These results link interface-driven lattice distortion to improved electromechanical output and identify all-oxide nanofiber heterostructures as a promising route to lead-free energy harvesting.

AI.tldr: HFO-BTO纳米纤维异质结构通过界面晶格畸变稳定铁电畴，并叠加摩擦电效应，实现24.31 μW/cm³功率密度，为纯BaTiO3的2.4倍。
AI.motivation: 压电纳米发电机（PENG）是自供电机械能收集的重要平台，但其输出常受退极化场、电荷泄漏及应力向活性偶极子传递效率低的限制，在聚合物主导的复合材料中尤为突出。因此需要寻找能改善界面耦合与机电转换效率的材料结构。
AI.method: 采用交替溶胶-凝胶静电纺丝制备HoFeO3-BaTiO3（HFO-BTO）纳米纤维异质结构，正交相HoFeO3（Pbnm）与四方相BaTiO3（P4mm）紧密共存。通过Rietveld精修XRD、高分辨TEM和拉曼光谱表征界面晶格畸变；用P-E电滞回线及开关电流评估铁电行为；将纤维封装于PDMS中并在循环冲击下测试电输出。
AI.result: 异质结构保持与BaTiO3相当的剩余极化（零场下16.39 vs 15.80 μC/cm²），开关电流峰值移至更高场（约7 vs 约3.5 kV/cm），符合应变稳定铁电畴。器件输出开路电压峰值约+6 V和-8 V，在4.7 MΩ负载下功率密度24.31 μW/cm³，分别为同等BaTiO3器件（10.00 μW/cm³）的2.4倍和HoFeO3器件（2.78 μW/cm³）的8.7倍；输出为压电响应与接触起电摩擦电贡献的混合。
AI.conclusion: 研究将界面驱动的晶格畸变与机电输出提升相联系，表明全氧化物纳米纤维异质结构是无铅能量收集的有前景途径。

title: Statistical decision theory in thermodynamics
summary: We introduce statistical decision theory in stochastic thermodynamic systems. Statistical decision theory integrates several statistical tasks, such as estimation, hypothesis testing, and classification. In this study, we consider statistical decision theory in stochastic thermodynamics, which unifies sensing, classification, and uncertainty relations. In particular, we focus on the minimax risk, the smallest achievable expected loss under the worst-case parameter choice, even with an optimal estimator. We derive lower bounds on the minimax risk using Le Cam's two-point method. The derived relationships can be used across a broader range of thermodynamic scenarios. To illustrate these relations, we study classification and distribution estimation problems in a Markov process. We demonstrate that the minimax risk provides lower bounds given by the dynamical activity in these problems. Furthermore, by examining particular dynamics, we establish that the resulting bounds simplify to uncertainty relations involving dynamical activity or entropy production.

AI.tldr: 本文将统计决策理论引入随机热力学，用Le Cam两点法推导极小极大风险下界，并证明其可化为涉及动力学活度或熵产生的信息-热力学不确定关系。
AI.motivation: 估计、假设检验、分类等信息处理任务在随机热力学中通常被分开讨论；作者希望用统一的统计决策理论框架把传感、分类与不确定关系联系起来，并刻画最优估计器下最坏情形的最小期望损失。
AI.method: 在随机热力学系统中定义极小极大风险（最坏参数下可达的最小期望损失），借助Le Cam两点法推导其下界；并在马尔可夫过程中具体研究分类与分布估计问题，结合动力学活度、熵产生等热力学量进行分析。
AI.result: 得到可适用于更广泛热力学情景的极小极大风险下界关系；在马尔可夫过程的分类与分布估计中，极小极大风险下界由动力学活度给出，且在特定动力学下这些界简化为涉及动力学活度或熵产生的不确定关系。
AI.conclusion: 统计决策理论可统一随机热力学中的传感、分类与不确定关系，极小极大风险为用动力学活度和熵产生等热力学代价量化信息处理精度提供了通用工具。

title: Proximity Transient Absorption in van der Waals Heterostructures
summary: Transient absorption spectroscopy is a widely used technique for investigating ultrafast electronic dynamics, where transient optical signals are generally interpreted as arising from excitations within the material hosting the probed optical transition. A distinct form of transient absorption spectroscopy, termed proximity transient absorption (PTA), is demonstrated, in which the probed optical transition and the monitored photoexcited carriers reside in different materials. Using graphene/hBN/WS$_2$ heterostructures, photoexcited carriers in graphene induce a strong transient optical response at the excitonic resonance of a WS$_2$ monolayer through Coulomb screening, even when the two layers remain electronically isolated by an atomically thin hBN spacer. The resulting signal follows the carrier dynamics of graphene rather than those of WS$_2$, demonstrating that the WS$_2$ exciton acts as an optical transducer of electronic processes in a neighboring material. The signal decreases systematically with increasing hBN thickness, confirming its proximity origin while remaining substantial for separations approaching 2 nm. PTA provides a noncontact approach for optically modulating one material using photoexcited carriers in another and enables probing of carrier dynamics in materials that are otherwise difficult to investigate directly. More broadly, PTA establishes a new modality of ultrafast spectroscopy and reveals that transient optical signals in van der Waals heterostructures can originate from excitations residing in spatially separated layers.

AI.tldr: 提出"邻近瞬态吸收"(PTA)谱学:用石墨烯/hBN/WS2异质结构证明一个材料中的光生载流子可通过库仑屏蔽调制另一材料的激子吸收,实现非接触式光学探测与调控。
AI.motivation: 传统瞬态吸收谱学默认瞬态光信号源自承载被探测光学跃迁的材料内部激发。作者希望探索一种情形:被探测的光学跃迁与所监测的光生载流子分处不同材料,从而拓展超快光谱的能力边界。
AI.method: 构建石墨烯/hBN/WS2范德华异质结构,两层被原子级薄hBN隔开、保持电学隔离。用光激发石墨烯中的载流子,观测WS2单层激子共振处的瞬态光学响应,并系统改变hBN厚度以验证信号来源。
AI.result: 石墨烯光生载流子通过库仑屏蔽在WS2激子共振处诱导出强瞬态响应;信号随石墨烯载流子动力学而非WS2动力学变化;信号随hBN厚度增加系统性减弱,但在接近2 nm间距时仍保持可观强度,证实其邻近起源。
AI.conclusion: PTA确立了一种新的超快光谱模态:WS2激子可作为邻近材料中电子过程的光学换能器。它提供了用一个材料的光生载流子非接触地光学调制另一材料的手段,并揭示范德华异质结构中的瞬态光信号可源自空间分离层的激发。

title: Boundary-Sensitive Quantum Order on Non-Amenable Lattices
summary: We show that quantum systems on non-amenable lattices, whose boundaries constitute an extensive fraction of the system, host novel forms of bulk ordering with no Euclidean counterpart. Combining boundary-retaining iDMRG with an exact symmetry-fixing duality, we investigate $p<5$ state clock models on the coordination-3 infinite Cayley tree. We find that between the ordered and disordered phases lies an emergent intermediate phase with bulk order induced by an arbitrarily weak boundary field rather than by conventional spontaneous symmetry-breaking. This establishes boundary-sensitive order as a distinct quantum ordering mechanism defying Landau's spontaneous symmetry-breaking paradigm. The intermediate phase realizes a bulk-boundary correspondence in which the unpolarized boundary selects a specific ordered bulk state.

AI.tldr: 非阿贝尔晶格上量子系统体态有序的新机制：任意弱边界场诱导的"边界敏感有序"相，超越了Landau自发对称破缺范式。
AI.motivation: 传统凝聚态物理中体态有序来自自发对称破缺，但非阿贝尔晶格（边界占比非零）可能提供无欧几里得对应的新型体有序形式，本文旨在探究这一可能性。
AI.method: 结合保留边界的iDMRG方法与精确对称性固定对偶变换，在配位数为3的无限Cayley树上研究p<5的态钟模型（state clock models）。
AI.result: 发现有序相与无序相之间存在一个涌现的中间相，其体态序由任意弱的边界场诱导，而非传统自发对称破缺；该中间相实现了体-边界对应：未极化的边界会选择特定的有序体态。
AI.conclusion: 确立了"边界敏感有序"作为一种独立的量子有序机制，违背了Landau自发对称破缺范式，揭示了非阿贝尔晶格上无欧几里得对应的新物态。

title: Nucleation-type criticality with infinite number of free-energy minima beyond mean-field theory
summary: We study the phase diagram of a three-dimensional Heisenberg model with Dzyaloshinski--Moriya interaction under the presence of Potts-like anisotropy. The phase transition between the winding phase and the ferromagnetically ordered phase exhibits a critical phase transition with anomalous features such as critical exponents consistent with that of a first-order transition while maintaining continuity of physical quantities. Furthermore, at the critical point, we see a growing number of free energy local minima, supporting the picture of infinitely many discontinuous transitions forming criticality. Our numerical result unify de Gennes' theory of nucleation-type transitions and Dzyaloshinskii's calculation of chiral magnets by demonstrating that such anomalous criticality can be realized in microscopic models beyond mean-field.

AI.tldr: 本文数值研究了含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与Potts类各向异性的三维Heisenberg模型的相图，发现螺旋相与铁磁相之间存在一种"临界却呈一级特征"的反常相变，并用自由能局域极小数目增长支持"无穷多个不连续跃迁构成临界性"的图像。
AI.motivation: 此前de Gennes的成核型相变理论与Dzyaloshinskii对chiral magnet的计算多在平均场层面给出反常临界性，缺乏微观模型中的非平均场验证；本文旨在证明这类反常临界性可在微观模型中真实出现。
AI.method: 对三维Heisenberg模型引入DM相互作用与Potts类各向异性，通过数值（相图计算）手段确定螺旋相与铁磁相之间的相变性质，并考察临界点附近自由能局域极小数量随参数的变化。
AI.result: 该相变表现为连续相变（物理量保持连续），但临界指数却与一级相变一致；在临界点处自由能局域极小数目不断增多，支持无穷多个不连续跃迁汇聚成临界性的图像。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明这类反常临界性可超越平均场、在微观模型中实现，从而将de Gennes的成核型相变理论与Dzyaloshinskii的chiral magnet计算统一起来。

title: Vacancy and Helium-Cluster Thermomigration in Tungsten
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to Nuclear Fusion
summary: Strong thermal gradients in tungsten plasma-facing components can bias the migration of irradiation-induced defects and thereby alter their redistribution, interaction, and retention. Here, we extend an atomistic jump-statistics framework previously developed for hydrogen to quantify the thermomigration of a single vacancy and interstitial He$_1$--He$_4$ clusters in body-centered-cubic tungsten. Non-equilibrium molecular-dynamics simulations performed over several thermal gradients are used to determine the directional jump ratio, while geometrically derived projected jump lengths convert the fitted directional-bias coefficient into the heat-of-transport coefficient $Q^*=αkT^2$, where $k$ is the Boltzmann constant, $T$ the temperature, and $α$ a constant. All investigated defects exhibit negative values of $α$, corresponding to net migration toward the hot region. He$_4$ has the largest response, $α=-2.2457\times10^{-2}$ K$^{-1}$, followed closely by the vacancy, whereas He$_3$ exhibits the weakest response despite its intermediate cluster size. Independent constant-temperature simulations over 1000--1600 K show that He$_3$ is also the least mobile cluster and has the largest effective migration energy, $E_m^{\mathrm{eff}}=0.271$ eV. In contrast, He$_4$ is more mobile than He$_3$ and has the smallest effective migration energy, 0.087 eV. Agreement between the He$_3$ concentration profile predicted from the jump statistics and that obtained from a long molecular-dynamics trajectory provides an independent validation of the method. These results show that thermomigration cannot be inferred from cluster size, diffusivity, or migration energy alone and provide defect-specific heat-of-transport parameters for higher-length-scale models of tungsten under fusion-relevant thermal gradients.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展原子跳跃统计框架，量化bcc钨中单空位和He1–He4团簇的热迁移，发现所有缺陷均向热区迁移（α为负），He4响应最强、He3最弱。
AI.motivation: 聚变堆钨等离子体面对部件中存在强热梯度，可能偏置辐照缺陷迁移并改变其再分布、相互作用与滞留，而缺陷热迁移（热泳）缺乏原子尺度定量参数。
AI.method: 将原用于氢的原子跳跃统计框架推广到空位和He1–He4团簇；非平衡分子动力学在多个热梯度下测定向跳跃率，结合几何投影跳跃长度把方向偏置系数转成热输运热Q*=αkT²。
AI.result: 所有缺陷α<0（净迁向热区）；He4响应最大α=-2.2457×10⁻² K⁻¹，空位次之，He3最弱；1000–1600 K恒温模拟显示He3迁移率最低、有效迁移能最大(0.271 eV)，He4最小(0.087 eV)；跳跃统计预测的He3浓度剖面与长MD轨迹吻合。
AI.conclusion: 热迁移不能由团簇尺寸、扩散率或迁移能推断，给出缺陷特异性热输运参数供更高尺度钨聚变模型使用。

title: Coupling Evaporation, Chemical Reactions, and Crystallization: A Population-Balance Framework Applied to Two-Step Perovskite Crystallization
summary: A limited understanding of how evaporation couples to crystallization pathways hampers control over the formation of solution-processed perovskite photoactive layers. Identifying these mechanisms-and learning how to select and tune them-is essential for achieving the desired crystal morphology and, ultimately, improving solar-cell performance and stability. To investigate crystallization pathways in evaporating thin films, we develop a simple and general zero-dimensional population-balance model that couples evaporation, chemical reactions, and crystallization. We use the model to explore a range of parameters for a solvent-solute system that follows a two-step crystallization pathway: solvent evaporation first induces formation of a crystalline precursor, which subsequently recrystallizes into the final phase. The model predicts the evolution of the film composition during drying and provides quantitative LaMer curves. Based on these results, we introduce a vocabulary of "supply limitations" and "rate limitations" that enables the interpretation of crystallization kinetics in terms of the governing process conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个零维种群平衡模型，将蒸发、化学反应与结晶耦合，用于解析溶剂蒸发诱导的两步结晶路径并给出定量LaMer曲线。
AI.motivation: 对蒸发如何与结晶路径耦合的理解有限，阻碍了对溶液法制备钙钛矿光活性层形成的控制；需识别并可调控这些机制以获得理想晶粒形貌、提升太阳能电池性能与稳定性。
AI.method: 构建简单、通用的零维(0D)种群平衡模型，耦合蒸发、化学反应与结晶；针对遵循两步结晶路径的溶剂-溶质体系（蒸发先诱导晶态前驱体生成，再重结晶为终相）扫描参数空间。
AI.result: 模型可预测干燥过程中薄膜组成的演化，并给出定量LaMer曲线；据此提出"供给限制"与"速率限制"的术语体系。
AI.conclusion: "供给限制/速率限制"框架可将结晶动力学与主导工艺条件对应起来，为选择和调控结晶路径、优化钙钛矿薄膜形貌提供理论工具。

title: Challenging Atomistic Foundation Models on Disordered Carbons
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models
summary: Foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) promise broad transferability, yet their out-of-domain reliability is hard to establish. Here, we use pure and O/H-containing disordered carbon spanning multiple phases, competing hybridisations and porous frameworks to stress-test six popular foundation MLIPs. We first screen all six on density functional theory (DFT) energy and force errors and binding curves, then subject four to melt-quench-anneal molecular dynamics and evaluate the resulting structural observables. Binding curves and O/H-containing trajectories reveal unphysical extrapolation and dynamical failures that low DFT energy and force errors fail to reveal. Of the models tested, MACE-MH-1 is the most consistently robust, with low DFT errors and stable MD. Despite differing architectures, OMAT-based models share structural biases, highlighting the importance of training coverage. All four models generate structures of nanoporous carbon that reproduce the principal experimental and specialised carbon potential signatures. Incorporating O/H leaves short-range order largely unchanged but shifts pore-size distributions towards larger pores. These results emphasise the need for application-specific validation and extend molecular dynamics modelling of nanoporous carbon towards experimentally realistic structures.

AI.tldr: 该文用纯碳及含O/H的多相无序碳体系对六个主流基础MLIP进行压力测试，发现低DFT误差不能保证动力学可靠性，MACE-MH-1最稳健。
AI.motivation: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）号称具备广泛迁移性，但其域外可靠性难以确立，尤其面对多相、混合杂化与多孔骨架等复杂无序碳体系时缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 以纯碳和含O/H的无序碳（涵盖多相、竞争杂化与多孔骨架）为测试集：先用DFT能量/力误差与结合曲线筛选六个MLIP，再对其中四个进行熔融-淬火-退火分子动力学模拟，并分析结构可观测量。
AI.result: 结合曲线与含O/H轨迹暴露出低DFT误差无法揭示的非物理外推和动力学失效；MACE-MH-1表现最稳定（DFT误差低、MD稳定）；不同架构的OMAT类模型存在共同结构偏差，说明训练覆盖度关键；四个模型生成的纳米多孔碳均再现主要实验及碳势特征；引入O/H基本不改变短程有序，但使孔径分布向大孔偏移。
AI.conclusion: 强调需针对具体应用做验证，并将纳米多孔碳的MD建模推进至更接近实验真实的结构。

title: Variational Block Correlated Coupled Cluster Monte Carlo
summary: Motivated by the recent success of quantum neural states, we present a variational implementation of the coupled cluster method suitable for quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We introduce a Young tableaux representation of the wave-function coefficients and their derivatives that substantially reduces the computational complexity of the variational optimization. While the algorithm is generic, we illustrate its implementation with an application to the Heisenberg model in one and two dimensions, using the block correlated coupled cluster ansatz (BCCC) with doubles and triples. Convergence is greatly improved by means of importance sampling based on a fictitious temperature. The resulting approach achieves competitive accuracy while providing a scalable framework for variational coupled-cluster calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种适用于量子蒙特卡罗模拟的变分耦合簇方法，利用Young表表示波函数系数及其导数以降低优化复杂度，并在Heisenberg模型上验证其高效性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 受量子神经态（quantum neural states）近期成功的启发，作者希望将变分耦合簇方法与量子蒙特卡罗结合，但面临变分优化计算复杂度高的难题。
AI.method: 提出变分耦合簇方法的量子蒙特卡罗实现：引入Young表表示波函数系数及其导数，大幅降低变分优化的计算复杂度；采用含双激发和三激发的块相关耦合簇（BCCC）ansatz；并通过基于虚拟温度的重要性采样改善收敛性。算法具有通用性，在一维和二维Heisenberg模型上进行了实例验证。
AI.result: 基于虚拟温度的重要性采样显著改善了收敛性；该方法在Heisenberg模型上达到了有竞争力的精度，同时为变分耦合簇计算提供了可扩展的框架。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法兼具通用性与可扩展性，虽然仅在Heisenberg模型上演示，但提供了一个有竞争力的变分耦合簇计算框架。

title: Phase-sensitive quantum-state texture during thermalization of a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Heisenberg dimer
summary: We investigate quantum-state texture during the thermal relaxation of an anisotropic spin-$1/2$ Heisenberg dimer subject to a longitudinal magnetic field and a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction. Starting from local transverse and longitudinal couplings to a bosonic bath, we construct a global weak-coupling Lindblad equation, identify its transition channels, and discuss the applicability and limitations of the secular approximation. The Gibbs state is obtained explicitly in the local spin basis, revealing that the DM coupling controls both the modulus and phase of the single-excitation coherence by modifying the energy splitting and rotating the chiral phase. For heating and cooling protocols, we compare rugosity, fidelity-based texture, and trace-distance texture with coherence, vector spin chirality, and purity. The relaxation dynamics separates population thermalization from the decay and precession of deliberately prepared energy-basis coherence. Their combined contribution to local coherence produces DM-dependent texture overshoots and, during cooling, damped oscillations and sign changes of the coherence quadratures. These transients differ from the evolution of coherence magnitude and purity, while trace-distance texture weights them differently from the overlap-based quantifiers. Calculations at reduced dissipation preserve the texture maxima within the secular model. The results identify a phase-sensitive diagnostic of relaxation.

AI.tldr: 研究了含Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与纵向磁场的各向异性自旋-1/2海森堡二聚体在热弛豫中的量子态"纹理"(texture)；建立全局弱耦合Lindblad方程并给出Gibbs态，揭示DM耦合通过改变能隙与旋转手性相位控制单激发相干性的模与相位。
AI.motivation: 希望在开放量子系统热化过程中寻找对相位敏感的弛豫诊断量，超越仅依赖相干幅值和纯度的传统刻画，明确DM相互作用与磁场下自旋二聚体弛豫的通道结构与相干动力学。
AI.method: 从局域横向/纵向玻色浴耦合出发构造全局弱耦合Lindblad方程，识别跃迁通道并讨论secular近似的适用性与局限；在局域自旋基下显式求解Gibbs态；对升温与降温协议，将rugosity、基于保真度的texture、迹距离texture与相干度、矢量自旋手性、纯度进行对比；并在弱耗散下检验secular模型的纹理极大值。
AI.result: DM耦合同时调制单激发相干性的模与相位（改变能级劈裂并旋转手性相位）；弛豫动力学可将布居热化与人为制备的能量基相干性的衰减和进动分离；两者对局域相干的联合贡献产生依赖DM的texture过冲，降温时出现阻尼振荡与相干正交分量变号；这些瞬态与相干幅值和纯度的演化不同，迹距离texture与基于重叠的度量对其加权方式也不同。
AI.conclusion: texture类量能捕捉相干幅值与纯度无法反映的瞬态相位敏感特征，可作为弛豫的相位敏感诊断工具；在弱耗散下secular模型仍保留纹理极大值。

title: A McLennan formula for equiaccessible steady states
summary: Near equilibrium, the Boltzmann distribution is corrected by the transient irreversible entropy flux, a result known as the McLennan formula. By expanding around equiaccessible steady states instead, we derive an analogue that can hold arbitrarily far from equilibrium. At zeroth order, steady-state occupation is determined solely by local escape rates, yielding a strong form of the active-matter principle of "low rattling." The first-order correction measures the impact of traffic imbalances on the accessibility of each state, marking the onset of nonlocal determinants of relative occupation.

AI.tldr: 本文将McLennan公式推广到等可达稳态附近展开，得到可远离平衡成立的类比公式：零阶仅由局部逃逸率决定稳态占据，体现"低抖动"原理的强形式，一阶修正刻画交通不平衡对可达性的影响。
AI.motivation: 经典McLennan公式仅在近平衡成立，稳态占据由瞬态不可逆熵流修正；作者希望找到一个能在任意远离平衡条件下描述稳态占据规律的理论框架。
AI.method: 不在平衡态附近展开，而改在以等可达稳态(equiaccessible steady states)为展开中心，对占据分布做微扰展开，逐阶分析局部逃逸率与输运/流量不平衡的贡献。
AI.result: 零阶项显示稳态占据仅由局部逃逸率决定，给出主动物质"低抖动"原理的强形式；一阶修正量化交通(流量)不平衡对各状态可达性的影响，揭示相对占据开始受非局域因素支配。
AI.conclusion: 等可达稳态展开为远离平衡的占据分布提供了系统级数，把"低抖动"原理与McLennan型修正统一起来，并指出非局域可达性效应从一阶开始出现。

title: Generative marginal learning for finite-size molecular simulation with application to stress calculation
summary: We propose generative marginal learning (GML), a framework for equilibrium sampling and local observable estimation in molecular simulations. By training a conditional diffusion model on large-system simulations, GML learns the marginal distribution of a retained region, enabling configuration generation without explicitly simulating the surrounding environment or imposing periodic boundary conditions on the retained region. We derive a marginal effective potential and the associated conditional mean-force identity, which provide the basis for both denoising and force-alignment training. As an application, we estimate the spatially averaged Irving--Kirkwood stress near a vacancy defect. Numerical results demonstrate that GML substantially improves pair structure and local stress accuracy compared with small periodic molecular dynamics simulations, mitigating finite-size effects in calculating local molecular observables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成边际学习(GML)框架，通过在系统级模拟上训练条件扩散模型，学习保留区域的边际分布，实现无需显式模拟环境或施加周期边界条件的构型生成与局部可观测量估计，用于缓解有限尺寸效应。
AI.motivation: 小体系分子动力学模拟受周期边界与有限尺寸效应影响，难以准确计算局部分子可观测量（如空位附近的应力），而显式模拟大环境代价高。
AI.method: 在大系统模拟数据上训练条件扩散模型，学习保留区域的边际分布；推导边际有效势与相应的条件平均力恒等式，作为去噪训练与力对齐训练的基础。
AI.result: 应用于空位缺陷附近空间平均的Irving–Kirkwood应力估计，数值结果表明GML相比小周期分子动力学显著改善了配对结构和局部应力精度。
AI.conclusion: GML可有效缓解计算局部分子可观测量时的有限尺寸效应，为平衡采样与局部观测估计提供了实用框架。

title: On Higher-Form Fracton Hydrodynamics with Momentum Conservation
summary: Momentum conservation is common in fluids, yet it may be incompatible with the hydrodynamics of theories with exotic conservation laws (such as fracton hydrodynamics) unless symmetries are spontaneously broken. Using the Martin-Siggia-Rose (MSR) effective field theory formalism, we develop a representation-theoretic framework for the hydrodynamics of translationally invariant systems with exotic conservation laws without spontaneous symmetry breaking. Under mild assumptions on the form of hydrodynamics, we show that such theories must satisfy two representation theoretic consistency conditions and a generalized Gauss's law constraint. Higher-form symmetries satisfy these conditions and we derive their ideal hydrodynamics; in three dimensions, the one-form case produces ideal non-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics. Finally, we prove that no other theories are compatible with momentum conservation in SO(3) nor SO($d$), for sufficiently large odd $d$.

AI.tldr: 本文利用MSR有效场论与表示论框架研究平移不变系统的流体力学，证明动量守恒对奇异守恒律施加了强约束。
AI.motivation: 动量守恒在流体中普遍存在，但与分形子(fracton)等含奇异守恒律理论的流体力学不相容，除非自发破缺对称性；作者希望在无自发破缺下理解哪些奇异守恒律可与动量守恒共存。
AI.method: 采用Martin-Swigla-Rose(MSR)有效场论形式，构建基于表示论的流体力学框架；在较温和假设下推导出两个表示论一致性条件与广义高斯定律约束，并对高形式对称性求解理想流体力学。
AI.result: 高形式对称性满足这些条件，作者由此导出其理想流体力学；在三维中一形式情形给出理想非相对论磁流体力学(MHD)；并证明在SO(3)及足够大奇数维SO(d)下，除高形式对称性外无其他理论与动量守恒相容。
AI.conclusion: 动量守恒极大地限制了奇异守恒律的流体力学，高形式对称性（如三维U(1)一形式对应MHD）是少数可行情形，为分类奇异流体提供了表示论判据。

title: Kondo Lattice model for field induced triplet pairing in CeRh$_2$As$_2$
summary: Spin triplet superconductors are of interest because of their topological properties, and their robustness to high magnetic fields. CeRh$_2$As$_2$ is a unique heavy fermion superconductor with both even-parity and candidate odd-parity superconducting phases with a special feature enabling a field induced phase transition between the two. The field induced transition which switches the parity of the Cooper pairs is enabled by a staggered antisymmetric spin orbit coupling (ASOC) interaction. However, the heavy fermion origins of the superconductivity in CeRh$_2$As$_2$ and the origin of the antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling are currently unexplored. Here, we develop a Kondo lattice model for CeRh$_2$As$_2$ and demonstrate how local hybridization between Cerium $d$- and $f$-orbitals, driven by the locally broken inversion symmetry, at the Cerium sites generates the ASOC. The resulting Kondo lattice model leads to nearly degenerate even and odd parity superconducting states that display a field induced parity transition between an even-parity state and an odd-parity pseudospin triplet state. We discuss the wider implications of our results extended to other heavy fermion systems like CeSiI.

AI.tldr: 本文建立CeRh2As2的Kondo晶格模型，指出局域反演对称破缺导致的Ce d-f轨道杂化产生反对称自旋轨道耦合(ASOC)，从而给出近简并的奇偶宇称超导态及场致宇称转变。
AI.motivation: CeRh2As2是同时具有偶宇称与候选奇宇称超导相、并能通过磁场诱导宇称切换的独特重费米子超导体，其转变源于交错ASOC。但其超导的重费米子起源及ASOC的来源此前未被探究。
AI.method: 构建CeRh2As2的Kondo晶格模型，以局域反演对称破缺下Ce位点d-f轨道局域杂化来生成ASOC，并分析由此得到的近简并偶/奇宇称超导态。
AI.result: 模型自然产生近简并的偶宇称与奇宇称超导态，并表现出由磁场诱导的、从偶宇称态到奇宇称赝自旋三重态态的宇称转变。
AI.conclusion: ASOC与重费米子超导均可由单一Kondo晶格机制统一解释，结果可推广到CeSiI等其他重费米子体系。

title: Rovibrational dynamics in strongly-coupled gas-phase methane
summary: Polaritons, the hybrid light-matter states formed when molecular transitions are strongly coupled to an optical cavity mode, appear to alter chemical dynamics, reactivity, and photophysics, though the mechanisms and reproducibility of these effects remain hotly debated. Nearly all reports in polariton chemistry rest on spectroscopic measurements of optical cavity transmission. Interpretation of these experiments therefore relies on understanding the linear and nonlinear spectroscopy of strongly-coupled systems. Working in the gas phase can dramatically simplify spectroscopic observables, as the intermolecular and environmental interactions that complicate the response of condensed-phase systems can be minimized. Our prior work introduced a platform for gas-phase molecular polaritons and demonstrated that linear cavity transmission spectra in the strong coupling regime are well described with classical Fabry-Pérot cavity physics. Here, we extend this platform to the nonlinear spectroscopy of cavity-coupled rovibrational transitions of methane. We monitor transient changes in the cavity transmission spectrum following optical pumping of intracavity molecules via an axis orthogonal to the longitudinal cavity axis. We find that the classical Fabry-Pérot cavity treatment quantitatively reproduces our transient spectra and allows for extraction of the collisional relaxation and transport timescales of intracavity molecules. We observe no difference in the dynamics of strongly-coupled methane versus free-space, non-cavity control experiments. This effort connects our gas-phase work to the much larger body of transient condensed-phase polariton spectroscopy and represents a step towards predictive understanding of molecular dynamics under strong coupling.

AI.tldr: 该工作将气相分子极化激元平台扩展到非线性光谱，对腔内甲烷转动-振动跃迁进行光泵浦瞬态透射谱测量，发现经典Fabry-Pérot腔模型可定量复现瞬态光谱，且强耦合甲烷与自由空间对照的动力学无差异。
AI.motivation: 极化激元化学中关于效应机制与可重复性争议很大，而几乎所有结论都依赖腔透射光谱测量，因此需要理解强耦合体系的线性与非线性光谱学；气相环境能最大限度减少分子间与环境相互作用，使光谱观测量大幅简化，此前该组已建立气相极化激元平台并验证线性透射谱可由经典腔物理描述，本文拟进一步检验非线性情形。
AI.method: 构建气相甲烷强耦合转动-振动跃迁体系，采用沿垂直于腔纵轴方向的光学泵浦激发腔内分子，监测腔透射光谱的瞬态变化（时间分辨瞬态透射光谱），并用经典Fabry-Pérot腔理论对瞬态光谱进行建模与拟合。
AI.result: 经典Fabry-Pérot腔处理可定量复现瞬态光谱，并据此提取腔内分子的碰撞弛豫与输运时间尺度；在强耦合甲烷与无腔自由空间对照实验之间，未观察到动力学差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究把气相工作与更广泛的凝聚相极化激元瞬态光谱研究联系起来，表明在此体系中强耦合本身不改变分子弛豫与输运动力学，是迈向强耦合下分子动力学可预测理解的一步。

title: Low-Field J-Coupling Spectroscopy Measured with a Diamond Nitrogen Vacancy Spectrometer
summary: Nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond (NVs) are point defects well suited to quantum sensing of magnetic fields. NV spin states can be initialized and read out optically with high spatial resolution, enabling detection of pL-scale volumes of nuclear spins. Using Coherently Averaged Synchronized Readout (CASR), standard NMR spectroscopy techniques such as free decay, spin echo, and PGSE have been performed with Hz-scale spectral resolution using NV-diamond sensors. However, using NV detection for conventional high-resolution NMR at multi-tesla fields is challenging due to the need to manipulate NV electronic spins at resonance frequencies 100 GHz or higher. Low-field J-coupling spectroscopy provides an alternative path to chemical resolution in a regime more easily accessible to NVs. Here, we demonstrate homonuclear and heteronuclear J-coupling spectroscopy using an NV-NMR spectrometer based on permanent magnets operating at $\sim$890 kHz proton Larmor frequency (bias magnetic field $\sim$21 mT). This field strength enables chemical characterization based on J-coupling using sequences such as Synchronized Echo (SyncE) and Spin-Echo Double Resonance (SEDOR), which do not require the strong chemical shift dispersion and pristine field homogeneity of high-field NMR. The frequency range is easily detected by NVs using standard XY dynamical decoupling sequences and is well-suited for applying Overhauser DNP, which can boost proton signal by two orders of magnitude. We acquire initial NV-NMR measurements of T$_1$, T$_2$, and Overhauser DNP in glycerol before advancing to SEDOR spectroscopy of methanol-$^{13}$C and a methanol-$^{13}$C/acetonitrile-2-$^{13}$C mixture at sample volumes $\sim$50 pL, in which we demonstrate measurement of $^1J_\text{CH}$ couplings and resolution between species. We also acquire a homonuclear J-coupling spectrum of a natural-abundance propylene carbonate sample.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用永磁体(~21 mT, 质子拉莫尔频率~890 kHz)构建NV-NMR谱仪,在低场通过J耦合(同核与异核)实现化学分辨,演示了~50 pL样品体积下甲醇-13C等的SEDOR谱及丙烯碳酸酯同核J耦合谱。
AI.motivation: NV色心适合高空间分辨磁传感,但多特斯拉高场下需~100 GHz以上操控NV电子自旋,难以做常规高分辨NMR;低场J耦合谱提供了NV更易实现的化学分辨路径,并便于结合Overhauser DNP。
AI.method: 搭建永磁体NV-NMR谱仪(~890 kHz质子频率,~21 mT);采用XY动力学去耦检测频率;使用SyncE同核与SEDOR异核J耦合序列;先在甘油上测T1、T2与Overhauser DNP(增强约两个数量级),再对~50 pL的甲醇-13C及甲醇-13C/乙腈-2-13C混合物及天然丰度丙烯碳酸酯测量。
AI.result: 测得T1、T2及DNP增强;在~50 pL体积样品中测得^1J_CH耦合并区分不同物种;获得天然丰度丙烯碳酸酯的同核J耦合谱。
AI.conclusion: 低场NV-NMR结合J耦合序列可在皮升级样品上实现化学分辨,无需高场化学位移色散；Overhauser DNP可显著提升灵敏度，为NV基微尺度化学分析提供可行路线。

title: Intermolecular Packing and Cooperative Stabilization in Nucleotide Monophosphate Crystals
summary: We examine the known polymorphs of cytidine 5$^\prime$-monophosphate (CMP) using dispersion-corrected density functional theory. The monoclinic phase is predicted to be the most stable, lying 1.76 and 3.00 kcal/mol per molecular unit below the orthorhombic and triclinic forms, respectively. Monoclinic CMP contains a ribose-based H-bonding motif along the crystallographic $\vec{b}$ direction, comprising alternating intra- and intermolecular interactions, motivating an investigation of cooperative stabilization along this pathway. We employ chain-of-molecules (COM) and chain-of-slabs (COS) models to quantify the direction- and size-dependent stabilization and extend the analysis to the corresponding 5$^\prime$-monophosphates of thymidine, uridine, adenosine, and guanosine. Successive dimer-addition energies reveal the strongest size-dependent cooperative stabilization along the $\vec{b}$ direction, whereas growth along $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{c}$ exhibits substantially weaker size dependence. Among the nucleotides examined, adenosine 5$^\prime$-monophosphate shows the strongest chain-growth stabilization in the COM model, whereas the uridine variant shows the strongest stabilization in the COS model. Guanosine 5$^\prime$-monophosphate exhibits the weakest response in both models. Minimal-basis iterative stockholder (MBIS) analysis further supports molecular polarization along the growing assemblies. These results demonstrate how nucleobase identity and the surrounding crystal environment modulate direction-dependent cooperative stabilization associated with extended hydrogen-bond networks.

AI.tldr: 用色散校正DFT计算CMP各晶型的相对稳定性，并用链-分子(COM)和链-板(COS)模型量化核糖氢键链沿不同方向的尺寸依赖协同稳定作用，扩展到其他核苷酸。
AI.motivation: 单斜CMP沿b轴存在交替分子内/分子间氢键的核糖基序，其协同稳定机制及其对核碱基种类和晶体环境的依赖性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 色散校正DFT计算CMP三种晶型能量；构建COM与COS模型并逐级加二聚体，评估方向与尺寸依赖的稳定化；扩展到TMP、UMP、AMP、GMP；用MBIS分析分子极化。
AI.result: 单斜CMP最稳定，比正交和三斜分别低1.76和3.00 kcal/mol每分子单元；b方向协同稳定最强，a、c方向很弱；COM中AMP最强、COS中UMP最强，GMP两者均最弱；MBIS证实随组装增长分子极化增强。
AI.conclusion: 核碱基身份与周围晶体环境共同调制与延展氢键网络相关的方向依赖协同稳定作用。

title: NIR-probe transient absorption on rubrene microcavities demonstrates no changes to singlet fission by strong coupling
comment: 16 pages, 4 main figures. Includes Supporting Information (55 pages total)
summary: Strong light-matter coupling has been proposed to control singlet-exciton fission, yet reported effects remain controversial due to the prevalence of cavity-induced optical artifacts in transient absorption measurements. Here, we investigate singlet fission in dielectric microcavities containing rubrene by probing in the near-infrared region, outside the cavity stopband, to eliminate mode-filtering artifacts. Across contrasting cavity quality factors ($Q = 90$ and $1150$) and a range of exciton-photon detunings ($+20$ to $-110$ meV), we find that the underlying kinetics are virtually identical to uncoupled films. Although minor spectral changes occur, transfer matrix simulations reveal these stem purely from mirror interference rather than modified photophysics. Transient electron paramagnetic resonance further confirms that high-spin triplet dynamics remain unperturbed. Together, these findings establish a widely applicable experimental framework for evaluating molecular photophysics in microcavities, revealing that singlet fission remains unaltered in strongly coupled rubrene.

AI.tldr: 在介电微腔中于腔禁带外的近红外区探测红荧烯的单重态裂分，发现不同Q值与失谐下激子动力学与未耦合薄膜几乎一致，光谱微小变化源于腔镜干涉而非光物理改变，强耦合下单重态裂分未被调控。
AI.motivation: 强光-物质耦合被提出可用于调控单重态裂分，但已有报道结论相互矛盾，主要原因是瞬态吸收测量中普遍存在腔诱导的光学伪影（模式滤波效应），难以区分真实光物理变化与测量假象。
AI.method: 在含红荧烯的介电微腔中，选择腔禁带之外的近红外波段进行探测以消除模式滤波伪影；对比两种腔品质因子（Q=90与Q=1150）及一系列激子-光子失谐（+20至-110 meV）；结合转移矩阵模拟与瞬态电子顺磁共振（tr-EPR）表征高自旋三重态动力学。
AI.result: 各腔参数下本征动力学与未耦合薄膜几乎相同；虽有轻微光谱变化，但转移矩阵模拟表明其完全来自腔镜干涉而非光物理改变；tr-EPR进一步证实高自旋三重态动力学未受扰动。
AI.conclusion: 强耦合红荧烯中的单重态裂分保持不变；该工作建立了可用于评估微腔中分子光物理的通用实验框架，并提示既往报道的调控效应可能源于光学伪影。

title: Vacuum-Field Squeezing by Molecules in Optical Cavities: An Exact Bound and Linear-Response Theory
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables; supplementary material (25 pages) appended
summary: The ground state of a molecule coupled to an optical cavity contains virtual photons, and squeezing of the photonic field has been found in exactly solvable models, perturbation theory, and numerical calculations. Here, two exact sum rules for the field quadratures show that, within the dipole approximation, the vector-potential fluctuations of a linearly polarized mode never exceed their vacuum value in the ground state of any molecule at any coupling strength. Consequently, the field is squeezed whenever the mode couples to a dipole-allowed transition from a nondegenerate ground state, and the cavity-induced ground-state energy shift cannot increase with the cavity frequency at a fixed coupling vector, which is an exact constraint on approximate methods. Moreover, the incoherent photon statistics, which exclude the coherent part of the field, are never sub-Poissonian. At weak coupling, an exact resolvent expression reduces the squeezing and the ratio of the anomalous to the normal photon moment to linear-response properties of the isolated molecule, with the ratio set by a mean excitation energy. Time-dependent density functional theory with CAM-B3LYP and PBE0 reproduces exact and QED coupled-cluster references for both quantities to within 5% at 45 benchmark points. A survey of 29 molecules gives mean excitation energies of 9.5-21 eV at a cavity frequency of 2 eV and shows that the most polarizable molecules squeeze the field the most.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了偶极近似下线性极化腔模的矢势涨落在任意分子基态中永不超过真空值，据此给出场压缩的两条精确求和规则及对近似方法的精确约束，并用量子化学方法在弱耦合下复现精确参考。
AI.motivation: 分子与光腔耦合的基态含虚光子，已有多种方法报道了光子场的压缩，但缺乏对压缩上限、发生条件及统计性质的普遍严格结论，也缺少对近似计算方法的精确约束基准。
AI.method: 在偶极近似框架下，通过构造场正交分量的两条精确求和规则，从理论上界定矢势涨落的上界；再结合弱耦合下的精确预解式（resolvent）表达式，将压缩量与反常/正常光子矩之比约化为孤立分子的线性响应性质；并用含CAM-B3LYP与PBE0的含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）与精确解、QED耦合簇结果进行基准对比。
AI.result: 矢势涨落恒不超过真空值，故当模式耦合到非简并基态出发的偶极允许跃迁时场必然被压缩；固定耦合矢量下腔诱导基态能量移动不能随腔频增大；非相干光子统计永不呈亚泊松分布；弱耦合下TDDFT在45个基准点上对两个量的误差在5%以内；29个分子在2 eV腔频下平均激发能为9.5–21 eV，极化率越大压缩越强。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出分子腔QED基态场压缩的严格上界与求和规则，为检验近似方法提供精确判据，并证实TDDFT可低成本高精度地预测弱耦合压缩与光子统计。

title: Transient Heat Conduction on Quantum Hardware: Replicated Temperature-Field Reconstruction and Shot-Count Sensitivity with a Variational Quantum Linear Solver
summary: Implicit discretizations of transient heat conduction repeatedly generate sparse linear systems, making diffusion problems a natural test bed for quantum linear solvers. This study evaluates how accurately a variational quantum linear solver (VQLS) recovers the temperature field produced by one backward-Euler step of one-dimensional conduction on IBM quantum hardware. A pre-specified confirmatory experiment compares N=4 interior temperatures encoded on two qubits with N=8 temperatures encoded on three qubits using ten paired hardware blocks; a separately defined N=16, four-qubit extension is evaluated in five independently scheduled exploratory blocks. Local VQLS optimization reduces relative temperature-field error to approximately 10^{-8} for all three cases, establishing an essentially exact ideal reference at this scale. On hardware, mean relative L2 temperature-field error is 8.07% for N=4 and 20.14% for N=8, a paired increase of 12.06 percentage points (95% CI, 10.71-13.42; exact paired sign-flip p=0.001953). The exploratory N=16 mean is 24.75+/-1.84%. A pre-specified N=16 shot-count follow-up then evaluates the same locked circuit at 2,048, 8,192, and 32,768 shots in six independently scheduled blocks. Mean field error remains 23.64%, 24.57%, and 24.37%, respectively; the 32,768-minus-2,048-shot contrast is +0.74 percentage points (95% CI, -0.65 to 2.12; p=0.281). In contrast, ideal multinomial sampling predicts a reduction from 2.68% to 0.75%. Higher shot counts reduce block-to-block variability but do not recover the mean cold-side temperature field. The results show that full-field readout of a strongly nonuniform thermal state is limited by more than ordinary finite-shot sampling under the tested hardware conditions, motivating observable-focused quantum formulations for heat flux, stored energy, and selected temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文在 IBM 量子硬件上评估变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）求解一维瞬态热传导 backward-Euler 一步的温度场精度：N=4 误差8.07%，N=8 为20.14%，N=16 约24.75%；提高测量次数（shot）可降低波动但无法降低均值误差，说明全温度场读出受限于超出有限采样之外的硬件因素。
AI.motivation: 瞬态热传导的隐式离散会反复产生稀疏线性系统，使其成为量子线性求解器的天然测试场景；但 VQLS 在真实硬件上恢复完整温度场的实际精度尚不清楚，需要严格的统计实验来量化其误差并找出误差来源。
AI.method: 对一维传导做一次 backward-Euler 步，将 N=4（2量子比特）、N=8（3量子比特）温度作为预设确证实验，配 10 组配对硬件块；N=16（4量子比特）为5组独立探索块。理想端用局部 VQLS 优化建立基准；硬件端测相对 L2 温度场误差并做配对符号翻转检验。后续预设 N=16 在 2,048/8,192/32,768 shot 下各6块，考察采样量影响并与理想多项式采样预测对比。
AI.conclusion: 提高 shot 数只减小块间波动，无法纠正冷端温度场的均值偏差，说明全温度场读出误差并非普通有限采样主导，而受其他硬件条件限制。因此建议转向以观测量为中心的量子建模，例如热流、储能和选定点温度，而非完整场读出。

title: Residual Carleman lift for nonlinear lattice Boltzmann simulations
summary: Low-order Carleman embeddings replace nonlinear dynamics by a larger linear system, but truncation errors can accumulate even when the underlying nonlinear model is accurately approximated by a quadratic equation. We construct a residual Carleman lift (RC2) of lattice Boltzmann dynamics in which an independently evolved spectral background supplies the coefficients and forcing of a second-order residual lift. In a double-shear-layer test, conventional fixed-rest Carleman reaches $87.3\%$ final error, whereas prepared RC2 achieves $0.136\%$ through vortex roll-up, without restarting the lift or using fine-reference feedback. The results demonstrate control of the finite-time accuracy of a fixed-order linear embedding through nonlinear preparation.

AI.tldr: 提出残差 Carleman 提升 (RC2)，用独立演化的谱背景为二阶残差提升提供系数与强迫项，从而抑制有限阶 Carleman 嵌入的截断误差累积。在双剪切层测试中，传统固定静止 Carleman 最终误差达 87.3%，RC2 仅 0.136%。
AI.motivation: 低阶 Carleman 嵌入可将非线性动力学替换为更大的线性系统，但即使原非线性模型能被二次方程很好地近似，截断误差仍可能随时间累积，导致有限阶线性嵌入的精度迅速退化。
AI.method: 构造格子 Boltzmann 动力学的残差 Carleman 提升 RC2：让一个独立演化的谱背景提供二阶残差提升所需的系数和强迫项，并通过非线性“准备”过程控制固定阶线性嵌入的有限时间精度，无需重启提升或使用精细参考解反馈。
AI.result: 在双剪切层算例中，贯穿涡卷起（vortex roll-up）全过程，传统固定静止 Carleman 的最终误差为 87.3%，而准备后的 RC2 最终误差仅 0.136%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过非线性准备可以有效控制固定阶线性嵌入的有限时间精度，RC2 是一种抑制 Carleman 截断误差累积的可行方案。

title: SIESTA-QCOMP: Bridging Classical and Quantum Computing for Strongly Correlated Systems
summary: Density Functional Theory (DFT) is the established workhorse of computational materials science, yet it faces fundamental challenges with strongly correlated electrons, such as in transition metal complexes and bond-breaking processes. While quantum computing offers a theoretically exact path to resolve these problems, current hardware limitations prohibit fully quantum simulations of realistic material systems. To bridge this gap, we present SIESTA-QCOMP, a modular suite embedding quantum methodologies within DFT. Harnessing SIESTA's localised basis set, we implement a projection-based embedding scheme that treats the bulk environment classically while mapping the strongly correlated "impurity" subspace to a quantum processor. The architecture uses a socket-based driver to orchestrate workflows between the Fortran-based SIESTA engine and Python-based frameworks like Qiskit, ensuring high interoperability. We detail the hybrid workflow, currently utilising a Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), and discuss the road map toward methods such as Sample-based Quantum Diagonalisation (SQD). We illustrate the framework on an hypothetical iron porphyrin calculation and argue that such hybrid architectures are not merely interim solutions but essential foundations for integrating quantum utility into materials design, as envisioned by our broader QCOMP4DFT initiative.

AI.tldr: 提出SIESTA-QCOMP模块化框架，将量子方法嵌入DFT：利用SIESTA局域基组做投影式嵌入，把强关联"杂质"子空间映射到量子处理器，环境按经典处理，实现量子-经典混合计算流程。
AI.motivation: DFT是计算材料科学的主力方法，但在过渡金属配合物、键断裂等强关联电子问题上存在根本困难。量子计算理论上可精确求解，但现有硬件无法完整模拟真实材料体系，因此需要混合架构作为过渡与基础。
AI.method: 基于SIESTA局域基组实现投影式嵌入：大块环境经典处理，强关联子空间映射至量子处理器。采用基于socket的驱动程序，协调Fortran编写的SIESTA引擎与Python框架（如Qiskit）之间的工作流，保证高互操作性；当前采用变分量子本征求解器（VQE），并规划向基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）等方法扩展。
AI.result: 给出了完整混合工作流细节，并在一个假想的铁卟啉算例上示范了框架的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 此类混合架构并非仅临时方案，而是将量子实用性融入材料设计的重要基础，与作者提出的QCOMP4DFT倡议愿景一致。

title: Second-Order Correction for Statistical Bias in Monte Carlo Depletion Calculations
summary: Depletion analyses are often driven by Monte Carlo neutron transport methods that introduce uncertainty into the transmutation matrix used to evolve a material composition. The nonlinearity of the matrix exponential applied to this transmutation matrix causes the uncertainty to introduce a systematic bias in the computed isotope vectors. This work derives a second-order correction for this bias that can be computed with quantities obtainable from typical Monte Carlo transport routines. An augmented Bateman system is formulated to evaluate these quantities and an adapted Chebyshev rational approximation method uses transmutation matrix factorizations for efficient evaluation of the second-order correction. Then, the correction is demonstrated using a ten-nuclide verification problem, an ITER port-plug activation problem, and a 9-pin boiling water reactor lattice containing self-shielded gadolinium-bearing fuel.

AI.tldr: 本文针对蒙特卡洛燃耗计算中嬗变矩阵不确定性导致的同位素浓度系统性偏差，推导了二阶修正方法，并用增强Bateman系统与改进Chebyshev有理逼近高效计算该修正。
AI.motivation: 蒙特卡洛中子输运给出的嬗变矩阵存在统计不确定性，矩阵指数对嬗变矩阵的非线性使得不确定性在演化后引入同位素向量的系统性偏差（而非零均值误差），需要一种可实际计算的偏差修正。
AI.method: 推导偏差的二阶修正项，使其可由常规蒙特卡洛输运程序可获得的量计算；构建增强Bateman系统来评估这些量；采用改进的Chebyshev有理逼近方法，利用嬗变矩阵分解高效计算二阶修正。
AI.result: 在十核素验证问题、ITER端口塞活化问题和含自屏蔽钆燃料的9棒沸水堆栅元问题中演示了该修正的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提二阶修正可在常规MC输运框架下高效实现，能有效减少矩阵指数非线性带来的同位素演化系统偏差。

title: Multigroup Implicit Monte Carlo Radiation Hydrodynamics on Moving Voronoi Meshes with STORM and RICH
comment: See STORM's paper at https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20639. This paper has been submitted to ApJS in October 2026. Comments are welcome and appreciated: maormiz@cs.huji.ac.il
summary: We present and validate an Implicit Monte Carlo (IMC) radiation-transport solver in the open-source, mesh-agnostic storm library, coupled to the moving-mesh hydrodynamics code rich in three-dimensional Voronoi tessellations. The solver is multigroup, or continuous in frequency, throughout; it transforms photon packets exactly between the comoving and laboratory frames, books every exchange with the material as a laboratory four-momentum so that the IMC path conserves energy to roundoff, formulates the Fleck factor in the fluid's proper time, and accelerates optically thick cells with multigroup Discrete Diffusion Monte Carlo (DDMC) behind an emissivity-preserving interface. We tested the solver on a broad suite of benchmark problems, and it performed well on all of them. The solver is built on the MPI-parallel Monte Carlo framework of storm, which scales to 13,440 cores.

AI.tldr: 在开源、与网格无关的 storm 库中实现并验证了隐式蒙特卡洛(IMC)辐射输运求解器，与基于三维 Voronoi 网格的移动网格流体程序 rich 耦合，在多类基准问题上表现良好，可扩展至 13,440 核。
AI.motivation: 辐射输运与（移动网格）流体动力学耦合需要能同时处理多群/连续频率、相对论性参考系变换、能量守恒与光学厚区加速的求解器，现有实现多为固定网格且缺乏严格能量守恒。
AI.method: 采用 IMC 方法，支持多群或连续频率；在共动系与实验室系间精确变换光子包，将所有与物质的交换记录为实验室系四维动量以保证能量守恒到舍入误差；Fleck 因子在流体固有时间中构造；对光学厚网格用多群离散扩散蒙特卡洛(DDMC)加速，并采用发射率守恒的界面耦合；求解器建于 storm 的 MPI 并行蒙特卡洛框架上，与 rich 的 Voronoi 移动网格耦合。
AI.result: 在广泛的基准问题测试套件上均表现良好，框架可扩展到 13,440 核。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个与网格无关、可在移动 Voronoi 网格上运行、能量守恒且可大规模并行的 IMC 辐射输运求解器，验证了方法在多种基准问题上的正确性与可扩展性。

title: A Unified Interface Neural Network for Elliptic Interface Problems
summary: We develop a Unified Interface Neural Network (UINN) framework for elliptic interface problems with discontinuous coefficients. A single shared network provides a unified representation of the solution in both subdomains, while a projection--correction construction embeds the solution and flux jump conditions directly into the neural trial space. This design aligns with the classical numerical principle of incorporating interfacial physics into the approximation basis to construct interface-unfitted numerical methods. The jump conditions are therefore satisfied exactly for any network parameters. Compared with methods based on separate phase networks and numerical formulations with interface penalty terms, UINN provides a unified representation with exact enforcement of interfacial jump conditions and interface-penalty-free optimization. Those features streamline the numerical formulations and can enhance training robustness. Numerical experiments on smooth interfaces at modestly large and high coefficient contrasts demonstrate UINN's solution accuracy, near-machine-precision satisfaction of the interface jump conditions, and enhanced robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出统一接口神经网络(UINN)框架求解具有间断系数的椭圆界面问题。单一共享网络统一表示两个子域解，用投影-校正构造将解与通量跳跃条件精确嵌入试探空间，实现跳跃条件对任意网络参数严格满足。
AI.motivation: 现有方法(分相独立网络、带界面罚项的数值格式)需分别建模或引入罚项，格式复杂、训练鲁棒性不足。希望将界面物理嵌入近似基，构造无需界面拟合、无需罚项的方法。
AI.method: UINN框架：单个共享网络统一表示两子域解；采用投影-校正构造，把解与通量跳跃条件直接嵌入神经试探空间；跳跃条件对任意参数精确满足；优化无界面罚项。
AI.result: 在光滑界面、中高系数对比度数值实验中，UINN展现出良好解精度、接近机器精度的界面跳跃条件满足度及更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 统一表示+精确跳跃条件约束+无罚项优化，简化数值格式并提升训练鲁棒性，为界面问题提供有效的免拟合神经求解途径。

title: Concurrent two-scale topology optimization of printable bone scaffolds via rectified-flow generation and exact latent-space refinement
summary: Bone scaffolds must reconcile a macroscale mechanical response with microscale geometric feasibility, yet conventional approaches to their design restrict attainable constitutive properties. This work presents a concurrent two-scale topology optimization framework; a conditional rectified flow generates periodic lattice microstructures, which are then refined in latent space by exact finite-element homogenization sensitivities. The resulting unit-cell geometries and their spatial assignments are jointly optimized under mechanical and feature-size constraints. In a distal rabbit femur benchmark, all eight flow-started refinements produce printable cells with maximum relative errors under 1\% across six prescribed engineering moduli. Constructing the implant from a single tiled cell reproduces intact whole-femur compliance within 0.1\% and regional strain energy within 0.35\% under four loading conditions. In human femoral reconstruction, multiscale concurrent optimization produces a cortical mid-shaft scaffold with porosity 63\% while satisfying the compliance constraint within 2\% under walking and stair-climbing loads. It achieves an 84\% porosity on a proximal cancellous scaffold with strain-energy deviations below 0.25\% under the same loads. Analysis of the learned representations reveals distinct architectural families in latent space. Further, the attention heads of the rectified-flow transformer specialize for spatial shifts -- learning the analogue of a finite-difference stencil -- and coordinate symmetries, with ablations showing their influence on generated topologies. These results establish a route to printable, mechanically constrained scaffold designs.
